basic_info.description: PromptCloud is a leading web data extraction company helping global businesses access clean, reliable, and real-time data to drive smarter decisions.Built on a Data-as-a-Service (DaaS) model, we combine cloud computing, automation, and machine learning to deliver structured web data feeds at scale. From product listings and reviews to news, social, and financial data, our platform transforms unstructured web content into machine-ready datasets that power AI models, analytics engines, and business intelligence tools.We believe reliable data is the foundation of every great product, insight, and strategy. That’s why our mission is simple - put high-quality web data at the heart of every business.As a fully remote team, we thrive on trust, autonomy, and growth. Every role at PromptCloud comes with a clear learning path and the freedom to innovate. We call it responsible flexibility; the space to do meaningful work, on your own terms, while building solutions that touch millions of lives.From Fortune 500 enterprises to fast-growing startups, we serve clients across eCommerce, Travel, Finance, Healthcare, Marketing, and Research - helping them extract, refine, and operationalize data with zero friction.Whether you’re training AI systems, enriching knowledge graphs, or powering competitive intelligence, PromptCloud delivers the data backbone that makes it possible.

past.employer_name: Calcutta School Of Tropical Medicine - India
past.employer_linkedin_description: School of Tropical Medicine (STM), is one of the seven such Institutions dedicated to research, care and cure of tropical diseases. STM was founded by Sir Leonard Rogers way back in 1914. The corridors of STM had regular footfall of eminent researchers like Leonard Rogers, Ronald Ross, R Knowels, UN Brahmachari, JB Chatterjee, RN Chopra and many others. The foundation stone of the School of Tropical Medicine was laid by the Governor. Lord Carmichael in the year 1914 on 24th February at the initiative of Sir Leonard Rogers.The School started functioning independently in its own building in 1921 with Lt. Col. JWD Megaw as the first Director, the first batch of students obtaining their Diploma in Tropical Medicine (DTM) in 1922. It is the only institution in India engaged exclusively in research, Post-graduate education and healthcare for tropical diseases. Basically, the objectives have remained uncharged and the school provides facilities for research, post-graduate teaching, training, investigation and treatment in tropical diseases. Presently the institute is under West Bengal University of Health Sciences that governs all the medical colleges in the state of West Bengal. The hospital section of the institute is known as Carmichael Hospital for Tropical Diseases. The Institute possesses a Centre of Excellence where advanced research is going on HIV/HBV Co-infection and Hepatitis B anti-viral therapy.

basic_profile.summary:
Entrepreneur with an EQ. A strategic thinker with well-rounded problem solving skills. Natural at understanding market landscapes and devising relevant solutions for steady business growth.

In 2012, I jumped the corporate ship to join PromptCloud in its very early days. Since then, I've driven the business from the forefront to grow PromptCloud into one of the most sought after brands for web data acquisition. PromptCloud is a leader in providing enterprise-based DaaS solutions at a large-scale. Having donned multiple hats throughout this journey, I now look after sales, marketing, products, HR and strategy divisions.

I also own JobsPikr, another solution from PromptCloud's portfolio, that provides deep insights into the labor market including job trends, skill trends, compensation trends along with the data when needed.

Prior to 2012, I had my stints at 3 of the big 4s- PwC, Deloitte and KPMG where I was doing techno-functional consulting.

I hold a Master's degree in Software Engineering from Carnegie Mellon and BTech in IT from BIT, Mesra.

I talk (less) big data, operations, business growth and philosophy. Happy to meet fellow co-founders and like-minded individuals to share learnings.

current.employer_linkedin_description: metacaps.ai brings to bear the power of cutting edge AI to help investors navigate capital markets with the highest possible downside protection. In a world of investing, where every fund manager is chasing the so-called "alpha" in returns so as to end up in the top quartile by the end of the quarter, metacaps.ai avowedly seeks stay away from any such a race. You ask why? It's because if equity markets crash by 40% (as they did during the onset of COVID), it's meaningless to tell your investors that your fund outperformed the broader markets and corrected only 35%!At metacaps.ai, our focus therefore is NOT necessarily on beating the index. Instead we have built some of the most sophisticated algos in the personal finance space that are geared NOT to maximise returns, but to maximise the probability (to 95%+) of decent returns (12%+ per annum) even during times of severe downturn in financial markets.
current.employee_description:
Myth: If you invest through SIPs in a disciplined manner for a period of 4-5 years, you will be able to very easily achieve at least a low double digit return of 11% - 12% per annum!

Fact: Historically, the probability of a 5-year SIP in the NIFTY-50 delivering an annualised return of 12% pa or higher has been less than 50% (47% to be precise)! That’s less than the probability of getting a flip of a coin!

At ANIINCaps, we’re trying to bridge this very gap between investor expectations and reality. We’ve built a set cutting edge AI-driven investment algos and an equally cutting edge technology platform to help our partner advisors and intermediaries achieve something really audacious for their clients - push up the chances of achieving a returns of 12% per annum or more to upwards of 90%!

current.employer_linkedin_description: Finpeg is one of India's first global macros driven robo-advisory platform. At Finpeg, we combine our unique understanding of global macros with the power of machine learning to create a very differentiated and unique proposition for our clients. This we believe is becoming ever more critical in today’s investment landscape where ETFs are triumphing over active management and actions of Central Banks have far greater impact on investment portfolios than the stocks and funds you pick for your portfolio, which in turn is rendering traditional methods of investing that have been focused on spotting that best rated fund and best rated fund manager ever more irrelevant. For e.g. if central banks are printing money and adding liquidity, we can have a raging bull run in equities even in the middle of a pandemic, and if central banks are draining liquidity (e.g. Jan 2018 to Sept 2019), even Buffet and Dalio wouldn’t be able to make you money in equities. And if real yields turn negative because of Central Banks suppressing interest rates and pushing them below the rate of inflation, hardly any asset class can outperform Gold during such times. At Finpeg, we have built a set of unique investment algorithms that are geared towards picking up these very global macro signals, and accordingly align our client portfolios to benefit the most from these emerging global macro trends.

current.employer_linkedin_description: metacaps.ai brings to bear the power of cutting edge AI to help investors navigate capital markets with the highest possible downside protection. In a world of investing, where every fund manager is chasing the so-called "alpha" in returns so as to end up in the top quartile by the end of the quarter, metacaps.ai avowedly seeks stay away from any such a race. You ask why? It's because if equity markets crash by 40% (as they did during the onset of COVID), it's meaningless to tell your investors that your fund outperformed the broader markets and corrected only 35%!At metacaps.ai, our focus therefore is NOT necessarily on beating the index. Instead we have built some of the most sophisticated algos in the personal finance space that are geared NOT to maximise returns, but to maximise the probability (to 95%+) of decent returns (12%+ per annum) even during times of severe downturn in financial markets.
current.employee_description:
Myth: If you invest through SIPs in a disciplined manner for a period of 4-5 years, you will be able to very easily achieve at least a low double digit return of 11% - 12% per annum!

Fact: Historically, the probability of a 5-year SIP in the NIFTY-50 delivering an annualised return of 12% pa or higher has been less than 50% (47% to be precise)! That’s less than the probability of getting a flip of a coin!

At ANIINCaps, we’re trying to bridge this very gap between investor expectations and reality. We’ve built a set cutting edge AI-driven investment algos and an equally cutting edge technology platform to help our partner advisors and intermediaries achieve something really audacious for their clients - push up the chances of achieving a returns of 12% per annum or more to upwards of 90%!

basic_profile.name: Neelima Vobugari
basic_profile.headline: Co-Founder, AiEnsured | Ethical & Responsible AI | Trustworthy AI & AI Governance Expert | Patent Holder | Forbes 200 India 2025 | Karnataka Mahila Ratna
basic_profile.summary: Technology entrepreneur, Co-Founder of AiEnsured, and Responsible AI & AI Governance expert with over 24 years of experience spanning enterprise technology, software quality engineering, artificial intelligence, digital transformation, innovation, and leadership.    My work focuses on helping organizations adopt AI responsibly, safely, and at scale through governance, testing, validation, risk management, and compliance frameworks. I am passionate about advancing Trustworthy AI and enabling enterprises to build AI systems that are fair, explainable, secure, reliable, and aligned with business and regulatory expectations.       As Co-Founder of AiEnsured, I lead initiatives in AI Testing, AI Validation, Responsible AI, Generative AI Governance, LLM Evaluation, and AI Risk Management. AiEnsured helps organizations assess and strengthen the quality, safety, fairness, explainability, robustness, and trustworthiness of AI systems.I am a patent holder with three published patents in Artificial Intelligence and Natural Language Processing:• 202041001672 – A System and a Method for Filtering and Categorizing Textual Information in Various Languages• 202041001669 – A System and a Method for Filtering and Categorizing Textual Information• 202041001685 – A System and a Method for Filtering and Categorizing InformationI have also filed a patent in LLM Testing and Validation:• 202411082693 – System and Method for Testing Large Language Models with Text Splitting and Enhanced Retrieval EvaluationThree patents relating to intelligent filtering and categorization of information have been published, and a fourth patent has been filed in the area of Large Language Model (LLM) Testing and Validation.       I have worked extensively with enterprises, academia, startups, and industry bodies to drive AI adoption, innovation, and technology transformation. I am also a speaker and advisor in Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Responsible AI, and AI Governance.    Areas of Interest: Responsible AI, AI Governance, Technology Governance, Cybersecurity, AI Security, Generative AI, LLM Evaluation, Regulatory Compliance, Financial Inclusion, and Enterprise AI Transformation.Awards and recognitions include Forbes 200 India 2025, Karnataka Mahila Ratna, Women in AI Award, Women Achiever Award, and multiple industry recognitions for contributions to Artificial Intelligence, innovation, and technology leadership.   I believe the future of AI lies not only in innovation, but also in building systems that are trustworthy, transparent, secure, inclusive, and accountable.

basic_profile.name: Jayapradeep Jiothis
basic_profile.headline: Senior Managing Partner, Stealth Skilling Solutions | Chief Product Officer, AIEnsured | Expert Trainer & Consultant in Software Architecture ,Testing ,AI & Agile
basic_profile.summary:
JP here—software technocrat, trainer, and consultant rolled into one, but with fewer bugs and more features! 
With over 25 years of experience, I've navigated the vast terrains of Product Engineering, Enterprise Software Architecture, AI & ML innovations, and Quality Assurance. Yes, I've seen legacy systems older than some of my trainees, but I've also spearheaded Agile transformations and architected cutting-edge Deep Tech solutions involving multi-faceted AI, ML Models, and agentic AI implementations.
As a Senior Managing Partner at Stealth Skilling Solutions and Chief Product Officer at AIEnsured, my day often swings between optimising GPU usage by 50% (cloud bills love me!) to delivering trainings with a Net Satisfaction Index that would make even the harshest critic nod approvingly. I’m also a Design Sprint enthusiast who believes that good solutions are ones built through collaboration—and yes, some sticky notes along the way.

Having trained over 8,000 hours with leading organizations like DaimlerChrysler, IBM, Bosch, Adobe, and Volkswagen, among others, I've come to one solid conclusion: real-world experience trumps textbook theories every single time. So, when I'm not architecting scalable cloud solutions or decoding ISO certifications, I'm busy turning practical failures (we’ve all had them) into teachable, certification-ready moments.
Whether you're wrestling with software architecture complexities, prepping for ISTQB or ISAQB certifications, diving into Agile and DevOps methodologies, or navigating the automotive industry's ASPICE maze—I'm your guy. Drop me a message; let's chat about how we can turn your team's skills into stealthy competitive advantages!
(And yes, the coffee’s on me when we meet!)

basic_profile.name: Jayapradeep Jiothis
basic_profile.headline: Senior Managing Partner, Stealth Skilling Solutions | Chief Product Officer, AIEnsured | Expert Trainer & Consultant in Software Architecture ,Testing ,AI & Agile
basic_profile.summary:
JP here—software technocrat, trainer, and consultant rolled into one, but with fewer bugs and more features! 
With over 25 years of experience, I've navigated the vast terrains of Product Engineering, Enterprise Software Architecture, AI & ML innovations, and Quality Assurance. Yes, I've seen legacy systems older than some of my trainees, but I've also spearheaded Agile transformations and architected cutting-edge Deep Tech solutions involving multi-faceted AI, ML Models, and agentic AI implementations.
As a Senior Managing Partner at Stealth Skilling Solutions and Chief Product Officer at AIEnsured, my day often swings between optimising GPU usage by 50% (cloud bills love me!) to delivering trainings with a Net Satisfaction Index that would make even the harshest critic nod approvingly. I’m also a Design Sprint enthusiast who believes that good solutions are ones built through collaboration—and yes, some sticky notes along the way.

Having trained over 8,000 hours with leading organizations like DaimlerChrysler, IBM, Bosch, Adobe, and Volkswagen, among others, I've come to one solid conclusion: real-world experience trumps textbook theories every single time. So, when I'm not architecting scalable cloud solutions or decoding ISO certifications, I'm busy turning practical failures (we’ve all had them) into teachable, certification-ready moments.
Whether you're wrestling with software architecture complexities, prepping for ISTQB or ISAQB certifications, diving into Agile and DevOps methodologies, or navigating the automotive industry's ASPICE maze—I'm your guy. Drop me a message; let's chat about how we can turn your team's skills into stealthy competitive advantages!
(And yes, the coffee’s on me when we meet!)

WHAYN is a full-stack platform that enables brands to launch medical, surgical, and pharmaceutical products without building the underlying infrastructure themselves. We're also building WINE (WHAYN Intelligence Network for Enterprises), a market intelligence platform that uses AI to detect technology and regulatory shifts early, giving our factory partners the foresight to make smarter investment and capacity decisions.

current.employee_description:
WHAYN is a full-stack platform that enables brands to launch medical, surgical, and pharmaceutical products without building the underlying infrastructure themselves. We handle everything from product development and regulatory approvals to manufacturing, quality assurance, and supply chain — so brands can focus on their market while we take care of the complexity behind the product.

Our manufacturing network spans multiple models — fully owned units, joint ventures, and partnerships — each aligned to specific product categories. This lets us maintain deep domain expertise and quality control across diverse product lines, from ortho support goods and surgical consumables to connected medical devices.

We're also building WINE (WHAYN Intelligence Network for Enterprises), a market intelligence platform that uses AI to detect technology and regulatory shifts early, giving our factory partners the foresight to make smarter investment and capacity decisions.

The core belief behind WHAYN: brands shouldn't need to become manufacturers to bring quality healthcare products to market, and manufacturers shouldn't have to guess where their industry is heading.

he Government of India, officially known as the Union Government, and also known as the Central Government, was established by the Constitution of India, and is the governing authority of a union of 28 states and seven union territories, collectively called the Republic of India. It is seated in New Delhi, the capital of India.The government comprises three branches: the executive, the legislative and the judiciary. The executive branch headed by the President, who is the Head of State and exercises his or her power directly or through officers subordinate to him.[1] The Legislative branch or the Parliament consists of the lower house, the Lok Sabha, and the upper house, the Rajya Sabha, as well as the president. The Judicial branch has the Supreme Court at its apex, 21 High Courts, and numerous civil, criminal and family courts at the district level.The basic civil and criminal laws governing the citizens of India are set down in major parliamentary legislation, such as the Civil Procedure Code, the Indian Penal Code, and the Criminal Procedure Code. The union and individual state governments consist of executive, legislative and judicial branches. The legal system as applicable to the federal and individual state governments is based on the English Common and Statutory Law. India accepts International Court of Justice jurisdiction with several reservations.

he Government of India, officially known as the Union Government, and also known as the Central Government, was established by the Constitution of India, and is the governing authority of a union of 28 states and seven union territories, collectively called the Republic of India. It is seated in New Delhi, the capital of India.The government comprises three branches: the executive, the legislative and the judiciary. The executive branch headed by the President, who is the Head of State and exercises his or her power directly or through officers subordinate to him.[1] The Legislative branch or the Parliament consists of the lower house, the Lok Sabha, and the upper house, the Rajya Sabha, as well as the president. The Judicial branch has the Supreme Court at its apex, 21 High Courts, and numerous civil, criminal and family courts at the district level.The basic civil and criminal laws governing the citizens of India are set down in major parliamentary legislation, such as the Civil Procedure Code, the Indian Penal Code, and the Criminal Procedure Code. The union and individual state governments consist of executive, legislative and judicial branches. The legal system as applicable to the federal and individual state governments is based on the English Common and Statutory Law. India accepts International Court of Justice jurisdiction with several reservations.

basic_info.name: Metacube Software Pvt Ltd
basic_info.description: Metacube is an IT Solutions and Services company with experience in developing enterprise applications and products for a wide spectrum of horizontal domains including global trade management, supply chain analytics, manufacturing analytics, business continuity planning, CRM, content management and eCommerce. These applications have been developed on a variety of platforms including J2EE, .Net and force.com. The common denominator in all our services has been our total client focus, ensuring that each engagement is a success and provides the desired value to the client.Metacube has software product engineering services as a key focus area, and brings in successful working experience with several product companies financed by leading venture capital funds such as Kleiner Perkins, Carlyle, Mayfield and Sequoia. These have been very demanding engagements challenging Metacube to deliver solutions that are generic, extensible, user friendly, and robust. Metacube also offers application engineering and software testing services.Metacube has gained rich experience in building and implementing on demand applications for enterprise. Software as a Service (SaaS) and Cloud  Computing are gaining fast acceptance and are expected to emerge as the dominant delivery models in future, leaving behind the current on premise infrastructure and licensed software models. Metacube plans to leverage this early mover advantage to help more organizations build software products based on the SaaS model, migrate products to the cloud and implement custom cloud based solutions. Metacube has a unique experience of working on a variety of cloud infrastructures including force.com, Google and Amazon

basic_profile.name: Keshav Sharma
basic_profile.headline: Founder, Metacube Software Pvt. Ltd.
basic_profile.summary:
Co-founder and Chief Executive Officer of CIStems  (Software) Ltd. since 1990. CIStems is an IT Solutions and Services Company based at Jaipur. 

CIStems in the initial years focused on providing IT education and training.  Starting with a single center, CIStems grew to a network of 20+ centers across Northern India. CIStems over the years trained more than 10,000 students, with several of them finding career in leading organizations including AT&T, Oracle, Sybase, Microsoft, Siebel, Sun, IBM, and Infosys. CIStems has been conferred upon four times the National Award for Excellence in IT Education by the Government of India. CIStems educational content was also published by Tata McGraw Hill. 

CIStems in the year 1999 diversified into providing onshore consulting and staff augmentation services in US. It was however adversely affected by the slow down in the US information technology industry. 

CIStems since Oct 2002 has successfully established itself as a trusted provider of engineering services to software product companies. It is working closely with enterprise solutions companies like Valdero, Informance, Aceva, Alysida, Harbinger TechAxes, and ShipMatrix. Amongst them these companies have been funded by leading venture funds including Kleiner Perkins, Mayfield, and Sequoia. The solutions from these companies are being used by likes of AT&T, Motorola, Juniper Networks,  Merck, General Motors, and Chevron.  

CIStems has gained excellent insight into nuances of product engineering, specially the Agile approach and the associated themes such as continuous testing and builds, short iteration cycles, pattern based development, and refactoring. 

The technology stack being used by CIStems includes Java, Servlets, Struts, EJB, JDO, SWING, JMF, JMS, JUnit, HTTP Unit, FIT, log4j, ant, Cruise Control, C++, CORBA, .Net, C#, ASP, Visual Basic, Oracle, MS SQL, MySQL, WebLogic, WebSphere, JBoss, Perforce, CVS, VSS, Test Director, Bugzilla, Silk  etc.

Specialties: Entrepreneurship, providing core business leadership, identifying business opportunities, creating and nurturing business divisions, defining marketing strategies, human resource planning and development, mentoring, sales presentations and closure, account management, software engineering, project management, technology selection, architecting solutions, educational content design, and teaching.

basic_profile.name: Keshav Sharma
basic_profile.headline: Founder, Metacube Software Pvt. Ltd.
basic_profile.summary:
Co-founder and Chief Executive Officer of CIStems  (Software) Ltd. since 1990. CIStems is an IT Solutions and Services Company based at Jaipur. 

CIStems in the initial years focused on providing IT education and training.  Starting with a single center, CIStems grew to a network of 20+ centers across Northern India. CIStems over the years trained more than 10,000 students, with several of them finding career in leading organizations including AT&T, Oracle, Sybase, Microsoft, Siebel, Sun, IBM, and Infosys. CIStems has been conferred upon four times the National Award for Excellence in IT Education by the Government of India. CIStems educational content was also published by Tata McGraw Hill. 

CIStems in the year 1999 diversified into providing onshore consulting and staff augmentation services in US. It was however adversely affected by the slow down in the US information technology industry. 

CIStems since Oct 2002 has successfully established itself as a trusted provider of engineering services to software product companies. It is working closely with enterprise solutions companies like Valdero, Informance, Aceva, Alysida, Harbinger TechAxes, and ShipMatrix. Amongst them these companies have been funded by leading venture funds including Kleiner Perkins, Mayfield, and Sequoia. The solutions from these companies are being used by likes of AT&T, Motorola, Juniper Networks,  Merck, General Motors, and Chevron.  

CIStems has gained excellent insight into nuances of product engineering, specially the Agile approach and the associated themes such as continuous testing and builds, short iteration cycles, pattern based development, and refactoring. 

The technology stack being used by CIStems includes Java, Servlets, Struts, EJB, JDO, SWING, JMF, JMS, JUnit, HTTP Unit, FIT, log4j, ant, Cruise Control, C++, CORBA, .Net, C#, ASP, Visual Basic, Oracle, MS SQL, MySQL, WebLogic, WebSphere, JBoss, Perforce, CVS, VSS, Test Director, Bugzilla, Silk  etc.

Specialties: Entrepreneurship, providing core business leadership, identifying business opportunities, creating and nurturing business divisions, defining marketing strategies, human resource planning and development, mentoring, sales presentations and closure, account management, software engineering, project management, technology selection, architecting solutions, educational content design, and teaching.

basic_info.name: Perfios
basic_info.description: Perfios is India’s largest SaaS-based B2B Techfin company, empowering 1000+ FIs to take informed decisions in real-time. Headquartered in Bangalore, India Perfios specializes in real-time credit decisioning, analytics, onboarding automation, due diligence, monitoring and more. Perfios’ core data platform has been built to aggregate and analyze both structured and unstructured data and provide vertical solutions combining both consented and public data for the BFSI space catering to their stringent Scale Performance, Security and other SLA requirements. Perfios secured $80 million from Teachers’ Venture Growth, the late-stage venture and growth investment arm of the Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan in March 2024. Earlier in FY 23-24, $229 Million was raised by Perfios in their Series D round from Kedaara Capital, marking the largest fund raise among Indian B2B SaaS companies for this financial year. Prior to this, Perfios raised $70 Million in Series C round from Warburg Pincus and Bessemer Venture Partners in February 2022. The latest round of funding has taken the total funding raised by Perfios to $435.1 Million.  In 2025, Perfios made three strategic acquisitions to further strengthen its position across the fintech value chain. In April 2025, Perfios acquired IHX, a leading healthcare information exchange platform that serves as the critical link between healthcare providers and payers, enabling seamless digital integration across the industry. In March 2025, Perfios acquired Credit Nirvana, an AI-powered debt collections and recovery platform that empowers financial institutions to maximize collections, reduce delinquencies and minimize cost, through data science-driven insights and intelligent automation.

Ispat Industries Limited (IIL) is one of the leading integrated steel makers and the largest private sector producer of hot rolled coils in India. Set up as Nippon Denro Ispat Limited in May 1984 by founding chairman Mr M L Mittal, IIL has steadily grown into a Rs 9,400-crore company, assuming its position as flagship of the reputed Ispat Group. A corporate powerhouse with operations in iron, steel, mining, energy and infrastructure, the Group today figures among the top 20 business houses in the country.Headquartered at Mumbai, IIL employs a total of 3000 people and is the leader in the national speciality steel market. The company's core competency is the production of high quality steel, for which it employs cutting edge technologies and stringent quality standards. It produces world-class sponge iron, galvanized sheets and cold rolled coils, in addition to hot rolled coils, through its two state-of-the art integrated steel plants, located at Dolvi and Kalmeshwar in the state of Maharashtra.The sprawling 1,200 acres Dolvi complex houses the 3 million tonne per annum hot rolled coils plant, that combines the latest technologies - the Conarc process for steel making and the compact strip process (CSP) - introduced for the first time in Asia.The complex also has a 1.6 million tonne per annum sponge iron (DRI) plant, which was commissioned in 1994 as the world's largest and most efficient gas-based single mega module plant. Moreover, the Dolvi complex is home to a 2 million tonne blast furnace and also boasts a mechanised multi-functional jetty situated nearby, that facilitates the automation of raw material handling. A new 2.24 million tonnes per annum sinter plant, a 1260 tonnes per day oxygen and a new electric arc furnace have also been commissioned at IIL Dolvi.

In March 2025, Perfios acquired Credit Nirvana, an AI-powered debt collections and recovery platform that empowers financial institutions to maximize collections, reduce delinquencies and minimize cost, through data science-driven insights and intelligent automation.

basic_profile.name: Tarun Khanna
basic_profile.headline: CEO - Perfios Insurtech, IHX & Remedinet
basic_profile.summary: I am an Enterprise Builder and Growth & Transformation Leader with 25+ years of experience building businesses, transforming institutions and creating new growth engines across Banking, Payments, Lending and Insurance—combining P&L, Strategy, Product, Technology, Digital, AI, Brand and Customer Transformation to turn complex opportunities into scalable businesses.Today, I am Leading Perfios Insurtech, with a mandate to build and scale a differentiated insurance technology business at the intersection of AI, Data, Intelligent Decisioning and Automation. My ambition is to help insurers transform underwriting, risk, claims, fraud, distribution and customer experience, while building Perfios into a strategic technology & intelligence partner for the insurance ecosystem.My career has consistently been about building what does not exist, transforming what needs to change and scaling what creates value.At HDFC Bank, I built the Dukaandaar Financing franchise from the ground up, combining OCEN, GST and cash-flow based underwriting with technology, risk guardrails, processes & a new sales ecosystem to create a ₹12,000 crore merchant lending portfolio.At Kotak Mahindra Bank, I led Digital Products and Digital Payments, building foundational capabilities for Asset Transformation - PL, Credit Cards & Home Loans Decisioning engine. Also led the Banks Payments across UPI, wallets & merchant acquiring.At Max Bupa, I helped build the Digital & Partnerships business to ₹120 crore in two years, while leading the digital platforms and performance marketing engine supporting its growth.Most recently, as President – Digital Business, Marketing & Strategy at IndusInd General Insurance, I led a broad enterprise mandate spanning Digital, Strategy, Marketing, Brand, Customer Experience, Distribution, Partnerships and AI-led transformation. I also led the transformation from Reliance General Insurance to IndusInd General Insurance, shaping its brand philosophy, customer promise, positioning, communication, visual identity and digital experience.My commercial foundation was built at Standard Chartered, where I progressed from frontline sales to regional leadership and Product/P&L roles, managing portfolios exceeding ₹50,000 crore, annual profit contribution of ₹500+ crore, and building a ₹1,600 crore Personal Loan franchise from scratch.I thrive where the opportunity is large, the path is ambiguous and the playbook does not yet exist.Building Businesses. Transforming Institutions. Developing Leaders.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Perfios is India’s largest SaaS-based B2B Techfin company, empowering 1000+ FIs to take informed decisions in real-time. Headquartered in Bangalore, India Perfios specializes in real-time credit decisioning, analytics, onboarding automation, due diligence, monitoring and more. Perfios’ core data platform has been built to aggregate and analyze both structured and unstructured data and provide vertical solutions combining both consented and public data for the BFSI space catering to their stringent Scale Performance, Security and other SLA requirements. Perfios secured $80 million from Teachers’ Venture Growth, the late-stage venture and growth investment arm of the Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan in March 2024. Earlier in FY 23-24, $229 Million was raised by Perfios in their Series D round from Kedaara Capital, marking the largest fund raise among Indian B2B SaaS companies for this financial year. Prior to this, Perfios raised $70 Million in Series C round from Warburg Pincus and Bessemer Venture Partners in February 2022. The latest round of funding has taken the total funding raised by Perfios to $435.1 Million.  In 2025, Perfios made three strategic acquisitions to further strengthen its position across the fintech value chain. In April 2025, Perfios acquired IHX, a leading healthcare information exchange platform that serves as the critical link between healthcare providers and payers, enabling seamless digital integration across the industry. In March 2025, Perfios acquired Credit Nirvana, an AI-powered debt collections and recovery platform that empowers financial institutions to maximize collections, reduce delinquencies and minimize cost, through data science-driven insights and intelligent automation.

Building the Intelligent Insurance Enterprise

The ambition is to move insurance technology beyond digitising existing processes towards intelligent, connected and decision-led insurance.

In March 2025, Perfios acquired Credit Nirvana, an AI-powered debt collections and recovery platform that empowers financial institutions to maximize collections, reduce delinquencies and minimize cost, through data science-driven insights and intelligent automation.

Credit Nirvana is an agentic AI platform for debt portfolio management and collections, purpose-built for banks, NBFCs, housing finance companies (HFCs), fintech lenders, and asset reconstruction companies (ARCs) worldwide. Maestro's agents plan, decide, and act autonomously across the entire delinquency curve — from early-bucket reminders to late-stage recovery — while remaining fully compliant and fully auditable at every step.Backed by Perfios' scale of working with 1,000+ financial institutions across 18+ countries and deep domain expertise in BFSI data, Credit Nirvana today manages:- 62M+ loan accounts- $21B+ in assets under management (AUM)- 9 loan portfolio typesOur vision: Every Receivable, Resolved.Whether you're a bank managing retail delinquency, an NBFC scaling secured lending recoveries, an HFC automating mortgage collections, a fintech lender optimizing early-stage outreach, or an ARC maximizing distressed asset recovery—Credit Nirvana's agentic AI turns collections from a cost center into a growth driver.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Perfios is India’s largest SaaS-based B2B Techfin company, empowering 1000+ FIs to take informed decisions in real-time. Headquartered in Bangalore, India Perfios specializes in real-time credit decisioning, analytics, onboarding automation, due diligence, monitoring and more. Perfios’ core data platform has been built to aggregate and analyze both structured and unstructured data and provide vertical solutions combining both consented and public data for the BFSI space catering to their stringent Scale Performance, Security and other SLA requirements. Perfios secured $80 million from Teachers’ Venture Growth, the late-stage venture and growth investment arm of the Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan in March 2024. Earlier in FY 23-24, $229 Million was raised by Perfios in their Series D round from Kedaara Capital, marking the largest fund raise among Indian B2B SaaS companies for this financial year. Prior to this, Perfios raised $70 Million in Series C round from Warburg Pincus and Bessemer Venture Partners in February 2022. The latest round of funding has taken the total funding raised by Perfios to $435.1 Million.  In 2025, Perfios made three strategic acquisitions to further strengthen its position across the fintech value chain. In April 2025, Perfios acquired IHX, a leading healthcare information exchange platform that serves as the critical link between healthcare providers and payers, enabling seamless digital integration across the industry. In March 2025, Perfios acquired Credit Nirvana, an AI-powered debt collections and recovery platform that empowers financial institutions to maximize collections, reduce delinquencies and minimize cost, through data science-driven insights and intelligent automation.

basic_profile.name: Krishna Chaitanya B
basic_profile.headline: Chief Product Officer @ Perfios | ex - SVP, Paytm | ex-Flipkart | FinTech | Product Management | Digital Lending | Credit Modelling | Personal Finance Management
basic_profile.summary:
Fintech Product Management professional with expertise in building FinTech businesses from scratch. Customer obsessed, detail oriented, pragmatic visionary with a high degree of business acumen and technical competency, and a proven expertise in leading technology businesses.

At Perfios, as the Chief Product Officer, will be spearheading multiple SaaS products for Indian and Global Fintech institutions; helping them future proof their businesses and category creation through technology.

Headed the Lending Product Team @ Paytm. Built a top notch team here to fulfil Paytm's vision of bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy - through one of its cornerstones - Lending. Scaled lending 8X to 66,000 Cr annual disbursal run rate, over 2 years. Built the Loan Management System, Loan Origination System, KYC Stack, Business Rule Engine, Integration and Collection Platform servicing effortless loan journeys across Personal Loan, BNPL, Co-branded Credit Cards and Merchant Loans. 

Was the Product Head for the Credit Risk & Insights (CRI) function in the Fintech & Payments Group (FPG) @ Flipkart. Also headed the Commercial Lending product and the Collections product. Was the P&L owner for the online stock broking business of Aditya Birla Capital. Was the founding member of India’s first account aggregation and personal finance management solution - Aditya Birla MyUniverse.

MBA from XLRI, Jamshedpur in 2008 and a Bachelor in Electronics & Communication Engineering from the National Institute of Technology, Karnataka in 2003.

Specialties: Lending, Product Management, Data Sciences, Fintech, Consumer Financing, Commercial Lending, Collections, Credit Risk, User Experience, Mobile Applications (Android & iOS), Analytics, Financial Services, Distribution

current.employer_linkedin_description: Perfios is India’s largest SaaS-based B2B Techfin company, empowering 1000+ FIs to take informed decisions in real-time. Headquartered in Bangalore, India Perfios specializes in real-time credit decisioning, analytics, onboarding automation, due diligence, monitoring and more. Perfios’ core data platform has been built to aggregate and analyze both structured and unstructured data and provide vertical solutions combining both consented and public data for the BFSI space catering to their stringent Scale Performance, Security and other SLA requirements. Earlier in FY 23-24, $229 Million was raised by Perfios in their Series D round from Kedaara Capital, marking the largest fund raise among Indian B2B SaaS companies for this financial year. Prior to this, Perfios raised $70 Million in Series C round from Warburg Pincus and Bessemer Venture Partners in February 2022. The latest round of funding has taken the total funding raised by Perfios to $435.1 Million.  In 2025, Perfios made three strategic acquisitions to further strengthen its position across the fintech value chain. In April 2025, Perfios acquired IHX, a leading healthcare information exchange platform that serves as the critical link between healthcare providers and payers, enabling seamless digital integration across the industry. In March 2025, Perfios acquired Credit Nirvana, an AI-powered debt collections and recovery platform that empowers financial institutions to maximize collections, reduce delinquencies and minimize cost, through data science-driven insights and intelligent automation.

past.employee_title: Chief Manager, Product - Aditya Birla Money MyUniverse
past.employee_description:
As the founding product manager for MyUniverse, was responsible for taking the MyUniverse platform from concept to launch on web, android and iOS.

Brought all the aggregation, advisory and reporting features to life by leading a team of business analysts, product managers, designers, analytics experts & engineers across more than 34 software and technology partners, driving more than 2000 man months of effort. 

Lead the user experience focus at MyUniverse by establishing the design and front end development teams. 

Executed the revamp of the home page of MyUniverse and reduced the drop off by 18 % despite a 4 fold increase in page views.

Revamped the core aggregation flow and improved the ratio of successful aggregators to registrations 
by 8X between Q1 and Q4 FY 2014 – 15.

Created the premier USP of MyUniverse: the rules based advisory engine, which provides automated, unbiased, comprehensive, N = 1 advice based on the aggregated data of the customer.

Created other critical features such as the investment portfolio, petty cash handling, weekly dashboard,  
customer life cycle management, customer acquisition framework & money snapshot. 

Increased the unique logins by 94 % in FY 2014 - 15 

Launched India’s 1st automated PFM app in 2013, which allowed the customer to have complete 
visibility and control on his finances, on the go. 

This was only the 2nd app in the world to have credential based account aggregation.

It reduced acquisition cost by 50 % and acquired over a million customers in 12 months. 

Today > 50 % of the traffic is driven on mobile assets and they also have > 45 % of the active base.

The MyUniverse app reached the top 5 in Android and # 1 in iOS among finance apps in India, in the first month of launch. 

Was part of the original team to have secured seed capital from the Chairman of Aditya Birla Group, and played a crucial role in getting external funding from International Finance Corporation.

past.employee_title: Head - Product, Business Strategy - Maxit, Conversion Funnel Improvement - MyUniverse
past.employee_description:
Head the product, operations, digital marketing, analytics, design, engineering and alliances effort for Maxit.

Maxit app solves a simple problem: It ensures that you don’t miss out on the hundreds of live offers on your own credit / debit cards by pinpointing the right offer, at the right time and the right place. It triangulates your location, your card and your previous spends and saves with every swipe.

Replaced credential based aggregation to sms based aggregation, improving adoption by 12X, and reducing acquisition cost by 100 %

Completed commercial acquisition of sms based aggregation code for Maxit and for further use in MyUniverse

Completely in housed the analytics capability to create a rule based engine delivering the right offer to customers based on the frequency, brands, amount and periodicity of spends.

Launched Maxit 2.0 in Jan 2017 after acquisition and integration of sms aggregation technology from BeeWise and addition of three new propositions: Best Card, Savings Tracker and In Store notifications

Implemented a real time savings calculator for every offer – card combination, which allows customers to look up the best card to use for achieving the highest savings through discount, cash back, reward points and free gifts. The same algorithm is also used to pitch the ultimate card a customer should have

Within a month of release of Maxit 2.0, aggregation jumped by 5X, and week2  re-logins by 3X from Maxit 1.0, and acquisition cost reduced by 15X

Also Head Product improvement efforts to increase conversion funnels across MyUniverse.

Lead the product, analytics and engineering effort needed to observe funnel drop offs, form hypothesis, run A/B tests to find solutions, iterate rapidly and apply the learning across similar funnels across MyUniverse.

Since Nov 2016, we achieved 5X conversion for the credit card online lead submission flow, improved investment account opening by 14X and conversion on instant personal loan landing pages by 2.5X

past.employer_linkedin_description: Ashok Leyland vehicles have built a reputation for reliability and ruggedness. The 5,00,000 vehicles we have put on the roads have considerably eased the additional pressure placed on road transportation in independent India.In the populous Indian metros, four out of the five State Transport Undertaking (STU) buses come from Ashok Leyland. Some of them like the double-decker and vestibule buses are unique models from Ashok Leyland, tailor-made for high-density routes.The blueprint prepared for the future reflected the global ambitions of the company, captured in four words: Global Standards, Global Markets. This was at a time when liberalisation and globalisation were not yet in the air. Ashok Leyland embarked on a major product and process upgradation to match world-class standards of technology.In the journey towards global standards of quality, Ashok Leyland reached a major milestone in 1993 when it became the first in India's automobile history to win the ISO 9002 certification. The more comprehensive ISO 9001 certification came in 1994, QS 9000 in 1998 and ISO 14001 certification for all vehicle manufacturing units in 2002. It has also become the first Indian auto company to receive the latest ISO/TS 16949 Corporate Certification (in July 2006) which is specific to the auto industry.

basic_profile.summary:
FinTech | Digital Lending | Alternative Data | Credit Modelling | Financial Services

Having worked at both Fortune 500 banks and a small data startup, my professional experience spans fintech, payments, and data monetization. The common thread that links each of these is a focus on building businesses from their inception stage to that of a self-sustaining entity. A reliance on data lies at the heart of these initiatives.
 
At Citi I have worked across teams, in Collections, Marketing, Sales, Product, Portfolio Management and across businesses including Savings/Checking accounts and Cards in Retail Banking. I built a multiple million-dollar P&L in the short span of two years launching a full suite of products and building out a sales team to grow the business. This intrapreneurial experience was a natural precursor to my startup experience.
 
Relative to Citi, DataWeave was much smaller and it presented a different and unique set of challenges as a result. At DataWeave, I consistently doubled revenues annually for each of the four years I was there. I acquired some marquee clients across Retail, FMCG, Consumer Brands and PE/VC firms across geographies and created two new product lines. The experience of working at Dataweave was an education in building data monetization businesses and working with unstructured data.
 
In my current role at Flipkart, I leverage Alternate Data across the Fintech offerings. My work includes supporting the Payments, Lending, Insurtech and the larger Fintech organization.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Perfios is India’s largest SaaS-based B2B Techfin company, empowering 1000+ FIs to take informed decisions in real-time. Headquartered in Bangalore, India Perfios specializes in real-time credit decisioning, analytics, onboarding automation, due diligence, monitoring and more. Perfios’ core data platform has been built to aggregate and analyze both structured and unstructured data and provide vertical solutions combining both consented and public data for the BFSI space catering to their stringent Scale Performance, Security and other SLA requirements. Perfios secured $80 million from Teachers’ Venture Growth, the late-stage venture and growth investment arm of the Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan in March 2024. Earlier in FY 23-24, $229 Million was raised by Perfios in their Series D round from Kedaara Capital, marking the largest fund raise among Indian B2B SaaS companies for this financial year. Prior to this, Perfios raised $70 Million in Series C round from Warburg Pincus and Bessemer Venture Partners in February 2022. The latest round of funding has taken the total funding raised by Perfios to $435.1 Million.  In 2025, Perfios made three strategic acquisitions to further strengthen its position across the fintech value chain. In April 2025, Perfios acquired IHX, a leading healthcare information exchange platform that serves as the critical link between healthcare providers and payers, enabling seamless digital integration across the industry. In March 2025, Perfios acquired Credit Nirvana, an AI-powered debt collections and recovery platform that empowers financial institutions to maximize collections, reduce delinquencies and minimize cost, through data science-driven insights and intelligent automation.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Perfios is India’s largest SaaS-based B2B Techfin company, empowering 1000+ FIs to take informed decisions in real-time. Headquartered in Bangalore, India Perfios specializes in real-time credit decisioning, analytics, onboarding automation, due diligence, monitoring and more. Perfios’ core data platform has been built to aggregate and analyze both structured and unstructured data and provide vertical solutions combining both consented and public data for the BFSI space catering to their stringent Scale Performance, Security and other SLA requirements. Perfios secured $80 million from Teachers’ Venture Growth, the late-stage venture and growth investment arm of the Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan in March 2024. Earlier in FY 23-24, $229 Million was raised by Perfios in their Series D round from Kedaara Capital, marking the largest fund raise among Indian B2B SaaS companies for this financial year. Prior to this, Perfios raised $70 Million in Series C round from Warburg Pincus and Bessemer Venture Partners in February 2022. The latest round of funding has taken the total funding raised by Perfios to $435.1 Million.  In 2025, Perfios made three strategic acquisitions to further strengthen its position across the fintech value chain. In April 2025, Perfios acquired IHX, a leading healthcare information exchange platform that serves as the critical link between healthcare providers and payers, enabling seamless digital integration across the industry. In March 2025, Perfios acquired Credit Nirvana, an AI-powered debt collections and recovery platform that empowers financial institutions to maximize collections, reduce delinquencies and minimize cost, through data science-driven insights and intelligent automation.

current.employee_description:

My primary focus will be on leveraging Perfios' strengths and capabilities to explore new avenues of expansion, both domestically and internationally. Fostering collaboration across Chief Product Officer, Chief Strategy Officer, Chief Technology Officer, Chief Growth Officer and Chief Financial officer to align and steer the organization in a strategy direction aligned to the market. Identify Operational inefficiencies and fix them with clear roles & responsibilities across the sales, specialist, Customer Success and connected organizations. Anticipate risks and plan mitigation plan proactively. Work with Finance team on overall financial interventions across the sales & associated organizations in managing finance, reporting & governance very well.

In today's rapidly evolving landscape, staying ahead of the curve is essential, and it is in Perfios’ innate DNA to remain at the forefront of innovation and transformation. Whether it's through enhancing our existing products and services or developing new, groundbreaking solutions, I believe that innovation will be a key driver of our future success.
Additionally, as we continue to grow and scale, I will continue to build on Perfios’s legacy of a customer-centric culture. I am confident that we will continue to push boundaries, drive innovation, & achieve new heights of success in the years to come.

Looked at design and architectural issues for the SCP product focusing on the infrastructural and integration aspects.

Asian Paints ABPP Upgrade

I  was  the ABPP Solution  Architect for the Asian Paints ABPP Upgrade   . The upgrade involved moving the i2  staging DMS to ABPP Data services , moving the CIS task scheduler to ABPP task scheduler and developing new planning workflows based on ABPP. The solution has gone  live with Master Planning , Deployment Planning, and Production Scheduler . I won a lot of praise from the customer for my continuous commitment in actively enabling the project from design to go live  This involved technical challenges in making the customer conversant with the platform, and  source code control tools that  they had never  used before. In this project, I’ve played multiple roles of analyst, architect, ABPP trainer, project management responsibilities in the absence of a full time project manager , mentoring of my colleagues , and development. One of the critical challenges was the design of a system with  multiple staging systems using ABPP . 
ABPP inherently did not have this capability and in close interaction with the ABPP architect , I came up with a best fit solution. There were various challenging architectural issues which were resolved with continuous interaction with SCP, FP, and ABPP product teams. Demonstrated excellent knowledge of various products including ODS, ABPP, CIS, Informatica, SCP, FP, ODSM, and FM .

Solution Design for Supply Planning at Sony, Japan

The project involved designing a Sales and Operations Planning(S&OP)  Solution at Sony using Supply Chain Planning Solver (SCP)  and the S&OP solution . This involved designing and building the adapters from SCP to S&OP and creating relevant reports in S&OP. Went to Japan for a month to understand the requirements and help enable the team back in India. 

Scenario Management

current.employer_linkedin_description: Perfios is India’s largest SaaS-based B2B Techfin company, empowering 1000+ FIs to take informed decisions in real-time. Headquartered in Bangalore, India Perfios specializes in real-time credit decisioning, analytics, onboarding automation, due diligence, monitoring and more. Perfios’ core data platform has been built to aggregate and analyze both structured and unstructured data and provide vertical solutions combining both consented and public data for the BFSI space catering to their stringent Scale Performance, Security and other SLA requirements. Perfios secured $80 million from Teachers’ Venture Growth, the late-stage venture and growth investment arm of the Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan in March 2024. Earlier in FY 23-24, $229 Million was raised by Perfios in their Series D round from Kedaara Capital, marking the largest fund raise among Indian B2B SaaS companies for this financial year. Prior to this, Perfios raised $70 Million in Series C round from Warburg Pincus and Bessemer Venture Partners in February 2022. The latest round of funding has taken the total funding raised by Perfios to $435.1 Million.  In 2025, Perfios made three strategic acquisitions to further strengthen its position across the fintech value chain. In April 2025, Perfios acquired IHX, a leading healthcare information exchange platform that serves as the critical link between healthcare providers and payers, enabling seamless digital integration across the industry. In March 2025, Perfios acquired Credit Nirvana, an AI-powered debt collections and recovery platform that empowers financial institutions to maximize collections, reduce delinquencies and minimize cost, through data science-driven insights and intelligent automation.

(a) Supply chain digital twin - Created a digital twin to experiment and model demand, inventory, sourcing, orders, network and the relevant constraints. It applies Advanced Predictive analytics to determine the outcomes of each experiment. These experiments are intended to mine insights needed for tactical and strategic decision making. basic_profile.name: V.R Govindarajan
basic_profile.headline: Co-founder Director at Perfios Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
basic_profile.summary:
An entrepreneur with 35  years of experience in the IT industry and an avid participant in the Database  Technology and AI communities.

Before co-founding Perfios Software, I was a co-founder and CTO at  Aztecsoft, a pioneer in the Offshore Product Development space. Aztecsoft went on to become a  listed company, that was acquired by Mindtree in 2008. 

Soon after exiting Mindtree, I started deliberating on the idea of consolidating and managing one's finances in a manner which provides a 360 degree view of one's financial standing. After much consideration, Perfios was developed in 2008 to do exactly this. Initially launched as a PFM App, Perfios successfully pivoted to a B2B analytics platform to  help lenders automate credit decisioning.

Today, Perfios has products and platforms to automate the entire customer journey from discovery,  application, KYC, data sharing, decisioning, disbursements, and credit monitoring. Perfios is helping over 500+ Financial Institutions in more than 15 countries digitize their lending process.

Apart from work, I am an avid reader, music lover, consummate cook, and mentor to entrepreneurs seeking to build a successful business patiently yet aggressively over the long term.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Perfios is India’s largest SaaS-based B2B Techfin company, empowering 1000+ FIs to take informed decisions in real-time. The latest round of funding has taken the total funding raised by Perfios to $435.1 Million.  In 2025, Perfios made three strategic acquisitions to further strengthen its position across the fintech value chain. In April 2025, Perfios acquired IHX, a leading healthcare information exchange platform that serves as the critical link between healthcare providers and payers, enabling seamless digital integration across the industry. In March 2025, Perfios acquired Credit Nirvana, an AI-powered debt collections and recovery platform that empowers financial institutions to maximize collections, reduce delinquencies and minimize cost, through data science-driven insights and intelligent automation.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Perfios is India’s largest SaaS-based B2B Techfin company, empowering 1000+ FIs to take informed decisions in real-time. Headquartered in Bangalore, India Perfios specializes in real-time credit decisioning, analytics, onboarding automation, due diligence, monitoring and more. Perfios’ core data platform has been built to aggregate and analyze both structured and unstructured data and provide vertical solutions combining both consented and public data for the BFSI space catering to their stringent Scale Performance, Security and other SLA requirements. Perfios secured $80 million from Teachers’ Venture Growth, the late-stage venture and growth investment arm of the Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan in March 2024. Earlier in FY 23-24, $229 Million was raised by Perfios in their Series D round from Kedaara Capital, marking the largest fund raise among Indian B2B SaaS companies for this financial year. Prior to this, Perfios raised $70 Million in Series C round from Warburg Pincus and Bessemer Venture Partners in February 2022. The latest round of funding has taken the total funding raised by Perfios to $435.1 Million.  In 2025, Perfios made three strategic acquisitions to further strengthen its position across the fintech value chain. In April 2025, Perfios acquired IHX, a leading healthcare information exchange platform that serves as the critical link between healthcare providers and payers, enabling seamless digital integration across the industry. In March 2025, Perfios acquired Credit Nirvana, an AI-powered debt collections and recovery platform that empowers financial institutions to maximize collections, reduce delinquencies and minimize cost, through data science-driven insights and intelligent automation.

past.employer_linkedin_description: AIA Group Limited and its subsidiaries (collectively “AIA” or the “Group”) comprise the largest independent publicly listed pan-Asian life insurance group. It has a presence in 18 markets – wholly-owned branches and subsidiaries in the Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong SAR(4), Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Australia, Cambodia, Indonesia, Myanmar, New Zealand, the Philippines, South Korea, Sri Lanka, Taiwan (China), Vietnam, Brunei and Macau SAR(5), and a 49 per cent joint venture in India. In addition, AIA has a 24.99 per cent shareholding in China Post Life Insurance Co., Ltd. The business that is now AIA was first established in Shanghai more than a century ago in 1919. It is a market leader in Asia (ex-Japan) based on life insurance premiums and holds leading positions across the majority of its markets. It had total assets of US$360 billion as of 30 June 2026.  AIA meets the long-term savings and protection needs of individuals by offering a range of products and services including life insurance, accident and health insurance and savings plans. The Group also provides employee benefits, credit life and pension services to corporate clients. Through an extensive network of agents, partners and employees across Asia, AIA serves the holders of more than 45 million individual policies and over 16 million participating members of group insurance schemes. AIA Group Limited is listed on the Main Board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited under the stock codes “1299” for HKD counter and “81299” for RMB counter with American Depositary Receipts (Level 1) traded on the over-the-counter market under the ticker symbol “AAGIY”.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Oracle is a global leader in AI, delivering the cloud infrastructure, data, and applications that organizations across the world trust to successfully achieve business outcomes at scale.Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) provides fast, flexible, scalable AI infrastructure. This enables organizations to operationalize AI without compromising data security or control. They include the only applications suite that brings AI to every aspect of a business, with AI-powered ERP, HCM, and CX applications, and the Oracle Health Suite which provides applications for managing the entire healthcare ecosystem. Oracle also provides industry-specific cloud application suites for more than two dozen industries and NetSuite, the world’s first cloud computing company. HDFC Bank is India's largest private sector bank, offering a comprehensive range of financial products and services to our customer base of over 92 million. Our extensive distribution network of 8,919 branches and 21,031 ATMs across 3,836 cities and towns as of August 2024, reaches every corner of the country, making us accessible to millions. Promoted by Housing Development Finance Corporation (HDFC), India's leading housing finance company, HDFC Bank began operations in 1995 with a simple mission: to be a "World-class Indian Bank". With a single-minded focus on product leadership, customer focus and operational excellence, we have emerged as a leading player in all our business segments. We cater to individuals and businesses, offering a full range of innovative banking solutions including loans, payments, and wealth management. Our business solutions empower companies of all sizes, from MSMEs to large corporations, helping them grow with tailored banking services and financial tools. In 2023, the Bank merged with HDFC Ltd, combining our robust banking services with HDFC Ltd's legacy of leadership in housing finance. This merger enhances our ability to offer home loans and other financial services, ensuring seamless access for customers across urban and rural areas. As a socially responsible corporate citizen, we believe in banking with a purpose. Through our CSR initiative, Parivartan, we actively work to drive positive change across education, healthcare, skills training, and sustainable livelihoods impacting over 10 crore lives across the country. Our commitment to community impact is as strong as our dedication to delivering value to our stakeholders. As we expand, we continue to stay at the forefront of innovation, offering seamless digital banking experiences to enhance the lives of our customers. past.employee_description:
Aztecsoft, started by S Parthasarathy and V R Govindarajan, was my first venture into startups. I was a founder member of the company. The vision of AztecSoft was to be a successful product company based out of India.

Joined as GM, R&D, I led the team to develop JPact, a Java based application server, conceived before the days of EJBs and J2EE. JPact was initially a multi-tier DSS product and eventually turned into a full-fledged application server with its own component-container model.

I subsequently architected Aztec ListServer Framework, a domain-specific solution on top of JPact App Server.

This was followed by various components and frameworks, such as ABIF (Aztec Business Integration Framework), which helped rapid development of applications by e-com startups.

Aztecsoft became closely associated with the e-com wave. Our team started working as an extension of the product development teams of our customers. Aztecsoft eventually perfected this model, creating a new category called OPD (Outsourced Product Development). I was engaged as a Solution Architect for multiple such customer products.

Aztecsoft went IPO in 2000, getting listed in BSE and NSE, and was acquired by Mindtree in 2008.

FORTRAN 77 Compiler under UNIX [APR 87 - JAN 88, AUG 88 - NOV 89, JUN 90 - OCT 90]

I worked as a member of the Compiler Group to do design and development of FORTRAN 77 compiler under UNIX platforms.  This work in various phases continued for three years.

Initial years of work, done as a team member, were on
•  Conversion of IR code generated by compiler front-end to AST, for code generation under Motorola 68020 processor
•  Revamping of the run-time libraries for both Intel i386 and Motorola processors, including use of math co-processors

Thereafter I proposed a new optimizing table-driven code generator based on Steve Tjiang’s work on a dynamic programming tool called TWIG (Ref: ACM TOPLAS Oct 1989). The proposal was accepted, and I started the development process with a small team. We developed TWIG in-house based on the specifications. Afterwards we developed the code generator using TWIG for the i386 architecture. The code generator was designed to convert ASTs to DAGs within Basic Blocks, perform several local optimizations including constant folding, algebraic transformations, common subexpression elimination, strength reduction and a few loop optimizations, and then convert DAGs back to trees for feeding to TWIG.  TWIG architectural specification was tailored to produce high quality locally optimized code. The performance of this compiler was comparable to the other FORTRAN 77 compilers in the international market.

After the release of the TWIG-based i386 compiler, we retargeted the compiler to Motorola Mc680x0.

COMMON LISP interpreter [FEB 88 - NOV 88]
I worked as the team leader for the design and implementation of a COMMON LISP (subset) interpreter, running under UNIX. The interpreter supported all the essential control structures and data types.  Nearly 60% of the standard COMMON LISP functions were implemented. A debugger and a LISP editor were among the major utilities supported as part of the LISP environment.

past.employee_description:
C compiler test suite [DEC 89 - MAY 90]
I worked as an independent developer at the Santa Clara software development site of Intel Corp. on the design and development of ORION, an architecture specific test suite for the Portland Group i860 C compiler. The main objective was to test code generation using software pipelining algorithm tuned for the said architecture. ORION consisted of
•  Static programs with different types of loops
•  A powerful program generator to generate loops with common subexpressions on random pattern or based on user specifications.

ABI verification suite [NOV 90 - FEB 92]
I worked as the Project Leader for iBCS2/psABI386 (Intel386 Binary Compatibility Specification 2 and Processor Specific Application Binary Interface Specification for Intel386 Architecture) Verification Suites development. The assignment was entirely carried out in India. The aim of these test suites was to standardize and stabilize UNIX System V Releases 4.3 and 4.4, so as to provide binary compatibility to applications.

Automation was done wherever feasible. A large part of the test suite was generated from Standard C Header files and other system information. The corresponding documentation in nroff-format was also generated.

MAIDA-SQL [MAR 92 - SEP 92]
I worked as the Project Leader to develop MAIDA-SQL, a tool for visual development of RDBMS-based end user applications. This job was done for ILOG Corp., France, using their GUI toolkit running on a wide range of platforms.  Programming was done in LeLisp, a dialect of LISP with object-oriented flavors. The work was executed partly in France and partly in India.

past.employee_description:
Engineering & Scientific Subroutine Library (ESSL) Optimization [JAN 93 - AUG 93]
I worked as a team member at IBM T. J. Watson Research Lab, NY, USA, on optimization of ESSL for the IBM POWER2 RISC architecture. The objective was to hand-optimize the ESSL routines so that for the architecture they perform close to the theoretical peak.  This was achieved by significant algorithmic changes in the ESSL code, followed by appropriate compiler options for use of specific hardware features, while keeping the source code for the library in FORTRAN 77.

PVS system software [SEP 93 - SEP 94]
I worked as a team member at IBM T. J. Watson Research Lab, NY, USA, on system software development for the IBM POWER Visualization System (PVS). PVS was a shared-memory based multiprocessor, capable of running applications that require high data bandwidth coupled with supercomputer-class computational ability. My projects involved development of:
•  Videomedia V-Lan interface library, which provided a common language to communicate to the Digital tape Recorders
•  Driver interface for a high performance video I/O card, capable of doing several D1 movie I/O in real time.

Tape file system [DEC 94 - JUL 95]
I worked as the Project Leader to develop a product called Phoenix, for IBM Tucson, AZ, USA.  The objective was to develop a file system on a tape jukebox, having multiple sequential tape drives and magazines of tapes, and equipped with automated media changer. The scope also included providing an API in C/C++ and GUI for ease of use.

DataLinks [APR 96 – APR 97]
This project was done for IBM Almaden, CA, USA. Considering that most of world’s data reside in file systems, not database, a new data type was required in IBM DB2 database which could tightly link the two, providing transactional integrity. This new datatype was called DataLinks. I worked on enhancing DB2 for providing support for the same. Several database libraries and utilities such as LOAD were enhanced in the process.

Headquartered in Bangalore, India Perfios specializes in real-time credit decisioning, analytics, onboarding automation, due diligence, monitoring and more. Perfios’ core data platform has been built to aggregate and analyze both structured and unstructured data and provide vertical solutions combining both consented and public data for the BFSI space catering to their stringent Scale Performance, Security and other SLA requirements. Perfios secured $80 million from Teachers’ Venture Growth, the late-stage venture and growth investment arm of the Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan in March 2024. Earlier in FY 23-24, $229 Million was raised by Perfios in their Series D round from Kedaara Capital, marking the largest fund raise among Indian B2B SaaS companies for this financial year. Prior to this, Perfios raised $70 Million in Series C round from Warburg Pincus and Bessemer Venture Partners in February 2022. The latest round of funding has taken the total funding raised by Perfios to $435.1 Million.  In 2025, Perfios made three strategic acquisitions to further strengthen its position across the fintech value chain. In April 2025, Perfios acquired IHX, a leading healthcare information exchange platform that serves as the critical link between healthcare providers and payers, enabling seamless digital integration across the industry. In March 2025, Perfios acquired Credit Nirvana, an AI-powered debt collections and recovery platform that empowers financial institutions to maximize collections, reduce delinquencies and minimize cost, through data science-driven insights and intelligent automation.

past.employer_linkedin_description: ING Vysya Bank has merged with Kotak Mahindra Bank with effect from April 1, 2015 and the combined entity bears the name - Kotak Mahindra Bank.

Export-Import Bank of India (Exim Bank) was set up in 1982 by an Act of Parliament for financing, facilitating and promoting India’s foreign trade.The Bank provides financial as well as value-added services to Indian exporters. Assistance is given to export-oriented units (EOUs) by way of term loans in Indian rupees or foreign currencies for setting up new production facilities, expansion/modernization or upgradation of existing facilities and for acquisition of production equipment or technology. The Bank lays special emphasis on extension of Lines of Credit to overseas entities, national governments, regional financial institutions and commercial banks. The Bank extends Buyers’ credit and Suppliers’ credit to finance and promote India’s exports and also has a programme called the Buyer’s Credit under National Export Insurance Account (NEIA) to facilitate medium and long term exports from India. To promote hi-tech exports from India, the Bank has a lending programme to finance R&D activities of EOUs. The Bank has a Marketing Advisory Services programme, which has been assisting Indian companies in identification of prospective business partners, facilitating placement of final orders and also identification of opportunities for setting up plants or projects or for acquisition of companies overseas. Exim Bank also has a a Grassroots Initiative and Development (GRID) programme which primarily envisages supporting relatively disadvantaged sections of society while creating expanded opportunities for traditional crafts persons and artisans, and rural entrepreneurs of the country.The Bank has a strong Research team which enables exporters to evaluate international risks, tap export opportunities and improve competitiveness, thereby helping them in their globalisation efforts. To know more about the Bank, visit: www.eximbankindia.in

About Kotak Mahindra Group:Established in 1985, the Kotak Mahindra Group is one of India’s leading financial services conglomerates. In February 2003, Kotak Mahindra Finance Ltd. (KMFL), the Group’s flagship company, received a banking license from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). With this, KMFL became the first non-banking finance company in India to become a bank – Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited.The consolidated balance sheet of Kotak Mahindra Group is over 1 lakh crore and the consolidated net worth of the Group stands at 13,943 crore (approx US$ 2.6 billion) as on September 30, 2012. The Group offers a wide range of financial services that encompass every sphere of life. From commercial banking, to stock broking, mutual funds, life insurance and investment banking, the Group caters to the diverse financial needs of individuals and the corporate sector. The Group has a wide distribution network through branches and franchisees across India, and international offices in London, New York, California, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Bahrain, Mauritius and Singapore. For more information, please visit the company’s website at https://www.kotak.bank.in/en/home.htmlNote: Our new toll-free number is 18004100.
