basic_profile.name: Sathyaseelan Murugesan
basic_profile.headline: VP of Engineering at Perfios
basic_profile.summary:
For over 18 years, I have operated at the intersection of product management, engineering, and business strategy, transforming complex objectives into world-class FinTech solutions that drive growth and market leadership.

My expertise is in architecting and executing large-scale digital transformations. I recently spearheaded the strategic initiative to consolidate multiple legacy tech stacks into a single, multi-line insurance platform. By pioneering an AI-driven Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)—from agentic code generation to automated testing and documentation—my team successfully delivered this complex project in just two quarters. This approach of fostering durable innovation has allowed me to build and scale high-performing, cross-functional organisations of over 80 members.

The results of this leadership are measurable:

- Increased platform conversion by 1.8x by launching a next-generation insurance platform.
- Reduced customer friction by 50% and doubled revenue-generating funnels through strategic UX re-engineering.
- Engineered systems to handle 16,000+ TPS to support 25x business growth.

As a leader, I excel at partnering with C-suite and stakeholders, translating deep technical capabilities into strategic business value. I am passionate about building the teams, technology, and strategy that will power the next phase of growth in the FinTech industry. I specialize in the system design of high-availability (99.9%+), privacy-first, and fully auditable platforms essential for financial services.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Perfios is India’s largest SaaS-based B2B Techfin company, empowering 1000+ FIs to take informed decisions in real-time. Headquartered in Bangalore, India Perfios specializes in real-time credit decisioning, analytics, onboarding automation, due diligence, monitoring and more. In March 2025, Perfios acquired Credit Nirvana, an AI-powered debt collections and recovery platform that empowers financial institutions to maximize collections, reduce delinquencies and minimize cost, through data science-driven insights and intelligent automation.

basic_profile.summary: Senior Technical Lead with experience in enterprise lending platforms, Loan Origination Systems (LOS), applicant onboarding, microservices modernization, and Agentic AI solutions.At Perfios, I work on lending and loan-origination journeys including applicant onboarding, borrower and co-applicant workflows, document collection, income verification, credit bureau integrations, banking APIs, and third-party ecosystem integrations.I have contributed to modernizing legacy and monolithic applications into scalable, independently deployable microservices using Java and Spring Boot. past.employer_linkedin_description: Perfios is India’s largest SaaS-based B2B Techfin company, empowering 1000+ FIs to take informed decisions in real-time. Headquartered in Bangalore, India Perfios specializes in real-time credit decisioning, analytics, onboarding automation, due diligence, monitoring and more. Perfios’ core data platform has been built to aggregate and analyze both structured and unstructured data and provide vertical solutions combining both consented and public data for the BFSI space catering to their stringent Scale Performance, Security and other SLA requirements. Perfios secured $80 million from Teachers’ Venture Growth, the late-stage venture and growth investment arm of the Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan in March 2024. Earlier in FY 23-24, $229 Million was raised by Perfios in their Series D round from Kedaara Capital, marking the largest fund raise among Indian B2B SaaS companies for this financial year. Prior to this, Perfios raised $70 Million in Series C round from Warburg Pincus and Bessemer Venture Partners in February 2022. The latest round of funding has taken the total funding raised by Perfios to $435.1 Million.  In 2025, Perfios made three strategic acquisitions to further strengthen its position across the fintech value chain. In April 2025, Perfios acquired IHX, a leading healthcare information exchange platform that serves as the critical link between healthcare providers and payers, enabling seamless digital integration across the industry. In March 2025, Perfios acquired Credit Nirvana, an AI-powered debt collections and recovery platform that empowers financial institutions to maximize collections, reduce delinquencies and minimize cost, through data science-driven insights and intelligent automation.

The Indian Institute of Science (IISc) was founded in 1909 as a result of the joint efforts of Jamsetji Nusserwanji Tata, the Government of India, and the Maharaja of Mysore. In 1886, Jamsetji Tata conceived of a university of science that would work for the benefit of India, and in 1898 created an endowment for establishing such an institution. The Government of India then took up the effort, and, in consultation with scientists in England and in India, decided to locate the Institute in Bengaluru, where the Maharaja of Mysore, Shri Krishnaraja Wodeyar IV, donated 372 acres of land. The Institute was formally vested in 1909, the foundation stone was laid in 1911, and the first batch of students started their studies in the same year.Over the last century, IISc has become the premier institute for advanced scientific and technological research and education in India. Beginning with 2 departments and 21 students in 1911, today IISc has 39 departments, units, or centres, 3500 students, and about 500 academic and scientific staff, supported by 600 administrative personnel. About 2200 students are in various PhD programs, almost 900 are enrolled for various Masters degrees, whereas about 400 are registered in the newly established, research oriented, four-year Bachelor of Science (Research) programme.In recent years, the Institute has vigorously promoted interdisciplinary research. New centres such as the CiSTUP, the Robert Bosch Centre for Cyber Physical Systems and a new Centre for Brain Research (funded by a large private endowment) are expected to conduct translational research in their respective areas, in order to better connect with industry and society. With the recent construction of modern buildings, acquisition of new research facilities, and induction of a large number of new faculty members, the Institute can look forward to an era of high productivity, increasing impact, and rising prominence in the world.

past.employee_description:
Aztecsoft, started by S Parthasarathy and V R Govindarajan, was my first venture into startups. I was a founder member of the company. The vision of AztecSoft was to be a successful product company based out of India.

Joined as GM, R&D, I led the team to develop JPact, a Java based application server, conceived before the days of EJBs and J2EE. JPact was initially a multi-tier DSS product and eventually turned into a full-fledged application server with its own component-container model.

I subsequently architected Aztec ListServer Framework, a domain-specific solution on top of JPact App Server.

This was followed by various components and frameworks, such as ABIF (Aztec Business Integration Framework), which helped rapid development of applications by e-com startups.

Aztecsoft became closely associated with the e-com wave. Our team started working as an extension of the product development teams of our customers. Aztecsoft eventually perfected this model, creating a new category called OPD (Outsourced Product Development). I was engaged as a Solution Architect for multiple such customer products.

Aztecsoft went IPO in 2000, getting listed in BSE and NSE, and was acquired by Mindtree in 2008.

FORTRAN 77 Compiler under UNIX [APR 87 - JAN 88, AUG 88 - NOV 89, JUN 90 - OCT 90]

I worked as a member of the Compiler Group to do design and development of FORTRAN 77 compiler under UNIX platforms.  This work in various phases continued for three years.

Initial years of work, done as a team member, were on
•  Conversion of IR code generated by compiler front-end to AST, for code generation under Motorola 68020 processor
•  Revamping of the run-time libraries for both Intel i386 and Motorola processors, including use of math co-processors

Thereafter I proposed a new optimizing table-driven code generator based on Steve Tjiang’s work on a dynamic programming tool called TWIG (Ref: ACM TOPLAS Oct 1989). The proposal was accepted, and I started the development process with a small team. We developed TWIG in-house based on the specifications. Afterwards we developed the code generator using TWIG for the i386 architecture. The code generator was designed to convert ASTs to DAGs within Basic Blocks, perform several local optimizations including constant folding, algebraic transformations, common subexpression elimination, strength reduction and a few loop optimizations, and then convert DAGs back to trees for feeding to TWIG.  TWIG architectural specification was tailored to produce high quality locally optimized code. The performance of this compiler was comparable to the other FORTRAN 77 compilers in the international market.

After the release of the TWIG-based i386 compiler, we retargeted the compiler to Motorola Mc680x0.

COMMON LISP interpreter [FEB 88 - NOV 88]
I worked as the team leader for the design and implementation of a COMMON LISP (subset) interpreter, running under UNIX. The interpreter supported all the essential control structures and data types.  Nearly 60% of the standard COMMON LISP functions were implemented. A debugger and a LISP editor were among the major utilities supported as part of the LISP environment.

past.employee_description:
C compiler test suite [DEC 89 - MAY 90]
I worked as an independent developer at the Santa Clara software development site of Intel Corp. on the design and development of ORION, an architecture specific test suite for the Portland Group i860 C compiler. The main objective was to test code generation using software pipelining algorithm tuned for the said architecture. ORION consisted of
•  Static programs with different types of loops
•  A powerful program generator to generate loops with common subexpressions on random pattern or based on user specifications.

ABI verification suite [NOV 90 - FEB 92]
I worked as the Project Leader for iBCS2/psABI386 (Intel386 Binary Compatibility Specification 2 and Processor Specific Application Binary Interface Specification for Intel386 Architecture) Verification Suites development. The assignment was entirely carried out in India. The aim of these test suites was to standardize and stabilize UNIX System V Releases 4.3 and 4.4, so as to provide binary compatibility to applications.

Automation was done wherever feasible. A large part of the test suite was generated from Standard C Header files and other system information. The corresponding documentation in nroff-format was also generated.

MAIDA-SQL [MAR 92 - SEP 92]
I worked as the Project Leader to develop MAIDA-SQL, a tool for visual development of RDBMS-based end user applications. This job was done for ILOG Corp., France, using their GUI toolkit running on a wide range of platforms.  Programming was done in LeLisp, a dialect of LISP with object-oriented flavors. The work was executed partly in France and partly in India.

past.employee_description:
Engineering & Scientific Subroutine Library (ESSL) Optimization [JAN 93 - AUG 93]
I worked as a team member at IBM T. J. Watson Research Lab, NY, USA, on optimization of ESSL for the IBM POWER2 RISC architecture. The objective was to hand-optimize the ESSL routines so that for the architecture they perform close to the theoretical peak.  This was achieved by significant algorithmic changes in the ESSL code, followed by appropriate compiler options for use of specific hardware features, while keeping the source code for the library in FORTRAN 77.

PVS system software [SEP 93 - SEP 94]
I worked as a team member at IBM T. J. Watson Research Lab, NY, USA, on system software development for the IBM POWER Visualization System (PVS). PVS was a shared-memory based multiprocessor, capable of running applications that require high data bandwidth coupled with supercomputer-class computational ability. My projects involved development of:
•  Videomedia V-Lan interface library, which provided a common language to communicate to the Digital tape Recorders
•  Driver interface for a high performance video I/O card, capable of doing several D1 movie I/O in real time.

Tape file system [DEC 94 - JUL 95]
I worked as the Project Leader to develop a product called Phoenix, for IBM Tucson, AZ, USA.  The objective was to develop a file system on a tape jukebox, having multiple sequential tape drives and magazines of tapes, and equipped with automated media changer. The scope also included providing an API in C/C++ and GUI for ease of use.

DataLinks [APR 96 – APR 97]
This project was done for IBM Almaden, CA, USA. Considering that most of world’s data reside in file systems, not database, a new data type was required in IBM DB2 database which could tightly link the two, providing transactional integrity. This new datatype was called DataLinks. I worked on enhancing DB2 for providing support for the same. Several database libraries and utilities such as LOAD were enhanced in the process.

Ispat Industries Limited (IIL) is one of the leading integrated steel makers and the largest private sector producer of hot rolled coils in India. Set up as Nippon Denro Ispat Limited in May 1984 by founding chairman Mr M L Mittal, IIL has steadily grown into a Rs 9,400-crore company, assuming its position as flagship of the reputed Ispat Group. A corporate powerhouse with operations in iron, steel, mining, energy and infrastructure, the Group today figures among the top 20 business houses in the country.Headquartered at Mumbai, IIL employs a total of 3000 people and is the leader in the national speciality steel market. The company's core competency is the production of high quality steel, for which it employs cutting edge technologies and stringent quality standards. It produces world-class sponge iron, galvanized sheets and cold rolled coils, in addition to hot rolled coils, through its two state-of-the art integrated steel plants, located at Dolvi and Kalmeshwar in the state of Maharashtra.The sprawling 1,200 acres Dolvi complex houses the 3 million tonne per annum hot rolled coils plant, that combines the latest technologies - the Conarc process for steel making and the compact strip process (CSP) - introduced for the first time in Asia.The complex also has a 1.6 million tonne per annum sponge iron (DRI) plant, which was commissioned in 1994 as the world's largest and most efficient gas-based single mega module plant. Moreover, the Dolvi complex is home to a 2 million tonne blast furnace and also boasts a mechanised multi-functional jetty situated nearby, that facilitates the automation of raw material handling. A new 2.24 million tonnes per annum sinter plant, a 1260 tonnes per day oxygen and a new electric arc furnace have also been commissioned at IIL Dolvi.

current.employer_linkedin_description: Perfios is India’s largest SaaS-based B2B Techfin company, empowering 1000+ FIs to take informed decisions in real-time. Headquartered in Bangalore, India Perfios specializes in real-time credit decisioning, analytics, onboarding automation, due diligence, monitoring and more. Perfios’ core data platform has been built to aggregate and analyze both structured and unstructured data and provide vertical solutions combining both consented and public data for the BFSI space catering to their stringent Scale Performance, Security and other SLA requirements. Perfios secured $80 million from Teachers’ Venture Growth, the late-stage venture and growth investment arm of the Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan in March 2024. Earlier in FY 23-24, $229 Million was raised by Perfios in their Series D round from Kedaara Capital, marking the largest fund raise among Indian B2B SaaS companies for this financial year. Prior to this, Perfios raised $70 Million in Series C round from Warburg Pincus and Bessemer Venture Partners in February 2022. The latest round of funding has taken the total funding raised by Perfios to $435.1 Million.  In 2025, Perfios made three strategic acquisitions to further strengthen its position across the fintech value chain. In April 2025, Perfios acquired IHX, a leading healthcare information exchange platform that serves as the critical link between healthcare providers and payers, enabling seamless digital integration across the industry. In March 2025, Perfios acquired Credit Nirvana, an AI-powered debt collections and recovery platform that empowers financial institutions to maximize collections, reduce delinquencies and minimize cost, through data science-driven insights and intelligent automation.

basic_profile.name: Tarun Khanna
basic_profile.headline: CEO - Perfios Insurtech, IHX & Remedinet
basic_profile.summary: I am an Enterprise Builder and Growth & Transformation Leader with 25+ years of experience building businesses, transforming institutions and creating new growth engines across Banking, Payments, Lending and Insurance—combining P&L, Strategy, Product, Technology, Digital, AI, Brand and Customer Transformation to turn complex opportunities into scalable businesses.Today, I am Leading Perfios Insurtech, with a mandate to build and scale a differentiated insurance technology business at the intersection of AI, Data, Intelligent Decisioning and Automation. My ambition is to help insurers transform underwriting, risk, claims, fraud, distribution and customer experience, while building Perfios into a strategic technology & intelligence partner for the insurance ecosystem.My career has consistently been about building what does not exist, transforming what needs to change and scaling what creates value.At HDFC Bank, I built the Dukaandaar Financing franchise from the ground up, combining OCEN, GST and cash-flow based underwriting with technology, risk guardrails, processes & a new sales ecosystem to create a ₹12,000 crore merchant lending portfolio.At Kotak Mahindra Bank, I led Digital Products and Digital Payments, building foundational capabilities for Asset Transformation - PL, Credit Cards & Home Loans Decisioning engine. Also led the Banks Payments across UPI, wallets & merchant acquiring.At Max Bupa, I helped build the Digital & Partnerships business to ₹120 crore in two years, while leading the digital platforms and performance marketing engine supporting its growth.Most recently, as President – Digital Business, Marketing & Strategy at IndusInd General Insurance, I led a broad enterprise mandate spanning Digital, Strategy, Marketing, Brand, Customer Experience, Distribution, Partnerships and AI-led transformation. I also led the transformation from Reliance General Insurance to IndusInd General Insurance, shaping its brand philosophy, customer promise, positioning, communication, visual identity and digital experience.My commercial foundation was built at Standard Chartered, where I progressed from frontline sales to regional leadership and Product/P&L roles, managing portfolios exceeding ₹50,000 crore, annual profit contribution of ₹500+ crore, and building a ₹1,600 crore Personal Loan franchise from scratch.I thrive where the opportunity is large, the path is ambiguous and the playbook does not yet exist.Building Businesses. Transforming Institutions. Developing Leaders.

past.employee_description:
Head the product, operations, digital marketing, analytics, design, engineering and alliances effort for Maxit.

Maxit app solves a simple problem: It ensures that you don’t miss out on the hundreds of live offers on your own credit / debit cards by pinpointing the right offer, at the right time and the right place. It triangulates your location, your card and your previous spends and saves with every swipe.

Completed commercial acquisition of sms based aggregation code for Maxit and for further use in MyUniverse

Within a month of release of Maxit 2.0, aggregation jumped by 5X, and week2  re-logins by 3X from Maxit 1.0, and acquisition cost reduced by 15X

Also Head Product improvement efforts to increase conversion funnels across MyUniverse.

Lead the product, analytics and engineering effort needed to observe funnel drop offs, form hypothesis, run A/B tests to find solutions, iterate rapidly and apply the learning across similar funnels across MyUniverse.

Since Nov 2016, we achieved 5X conversion for the credit card online lead submission flow, improved investment account opening by 14X and conversion on instant personal loan landing pages by 2.5X

current.employer_linkedin_description: Perfios is India’s largest SaaS-based B2B Techfin company, empowering 1000+ FIs to take informed decisions in real-time. In April 2025, Perfios acquired IHX, a leading healthcare information exchange platform that serves as the critical link between healthcare providers and payers, enabling seamless digital integration across the industry. In March 2025, Perfios acquired Credit Nirvana, an AI-powered debt collections and recovery platform that empowers financial institutions to maximize collections, reduce delinquencies and minimize cost, through data science-driven insights and intelligent automation.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Zomato’s mission statement is “better food for more people.” Since our inception in 2010, we have grown tremendously, both in scope and scale - and emerged as India’s most trusted brand during the pandemic, along with being one of the largest hyperlocal delivery networks in the country.Today, Zomato represents a wide range of cultures through its diversified 5000+ team members, 3.5 lakh+ delivery partners, and our biggest collective of the finest restaurant partners. We are grateful that our business is able to provide upward social and economic movement for millions of households – of our delivery partners, as well as restaurant staff. We think of all of us as one big family!Our passion is driven by purpose and we take immense pride in our initiative ‘Feeding India’, one of India’s largest not-for-profits working to ensure that nobody in India goes to bed hungry. As of now, Feeding India provides over 150,000 nutritious meals to the underprivileged every day.In April 2020, Feeding India ran one of the largest food distribution drives in the world during the first wave of COVID, and distributed 78 million meals to daily wagers across the length and breadth of the country.During the second wave of COVID-19, Feeding India was again the first to act. We were able to source over 9,000 oxygen concentrators and distributed them for free to government hospitals across the country. This helped save millions of lives during one of the worst humanitarian crises faced by India in the recent times.We’re innovating hard to make last-mile delivery carbon neutral, to eliminate the use of plastic packaging, create meaningful opportunities in the gig economy, and to feed our country’s ever-growing appetite for high-quality, affordable, and hygienic food, one delivery at a time!

basic_profile.summary:
About Pawnesh Agency

Pawnesh Agency is a pioneering organization in the digital entertainment and social media industry, specializing in managing and supporting live chat room hosts on ShareChat. With years of hands-on experience, we have cultivated an unmatched expertise in onboarding, training, and guiding hosts to achieve their maximum potential.

Our agency has built a reputation for providing comprehensive solutions that enhance engagement, virality, and host performance. We pride ourselves on our ability to adapt to the dynamic digital landscape and deliver tailored strategies to foster the growth of both new and seasoned hosts.

Key Skills and Expertise:

Host Management: Ensuring top-tier performance through personalized guidance, training, and mentorship.

Engagement Strategies: Boosting chat room participation and creating viral content that resonates with diverse audiences.

Technical Proficiency: Leveraging ShareChat's platform features to maximize host earnings through virtual gifting.

Problem Solving: Providing prompt and efficient solutions to host queries and challenges, ensuring smooth operations.


Achievements:

Successfully managed and trained a diverse group of hosts, many of whom have become leading influencers on the platform.

Recognized for delivering exceptional support and innovative solutions that have significantly enhanced host earnings and audience engagement.

Built long-term, trust-based relationships with both hosts and platform stakeholders, cementing our reputation as a reliable and results-oriented agency.


With a commitment to excellence and a passion for nurturing talent, Pawnesh Agency stands at the forefront of the digital content creation industry. Our journey is a testament to our dedication to empowering individuals and driving innovation in the social media ecosystem.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Zomato’s mission statement is “better food for more people.” Since our inception in 2010, we have grown tremendously, both in scope and scale - and emerged as India’s most trusted brand during the pandemic, along with being one of the largest hyperlocal delivery networks in the country.Today, Zomato represents a wide range of cultures through its diversified 5000+ team members, 3.5 lakh+ delivery partners, and our biggest collective of the finest restaurant partners. We are grateful that our business is able to provide upward social and economic movement for millions of households – of our delivery partners, as well as restaurant staff. We think of all of us as one big family!Our passion is driven by purpose and we take immense pride in our initiative ‘Feeding India’, one of India’s largest not-for-profits working to ensure that nobody in India goes to bed hungry. As of now, Feeding India provides over 150,000 nutritious meals to the underprivileged every day.In April 2020, Feeding India ran one of the largest food distribution drives in the world during the first wave of COVID, and distributed 78 million meals to daily wagers across the length and breadth of the country.During the second wave of COVID-19, Feeding India was again the first to act. We were able to source over 9,000 oxygen concentrators and distributed them for free to government hospitals across the country. This helped save millions of lives during one of the worst humanitarian crises faced by India in the recent times.We’re innovating hard to make last-mile delivery carbon neutral, to eliminate the use of plastic packaging, create meaningful opportunities in the gig economy, and to feed our country’s ever-growing appetite for high-quality, affordable, and hygienic food, one delivery at a time!

Pawnesh Agency is a pioneering organization in the digital entertainment and social media industry, specializing in managing and supporting live chat room hosts on ShareChat. Built long-term, trust-based relationships with both hosts and platform stakeholders, cementing our reputation as a reliable and results-oriented agency.

Airtel was founded to provide global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our organization embodies a unique blend of energy, innovation, creativity, dedication, scale, and ownership, all aimed at being limitless. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for our consumers.  Our team is highly skilled and constantly growing, actively developing infrastructure to introduce cutting-edge technologies like 5G, IoT, IQ, and Airtel Black. We have successfully launched 5G services in over 5,000 cities and towns nationwide, with 10 million unique customers on the 5G network nationally. Airtel Black is another convenient consumer service that provides combined billing for family and friends under a single bill. We also offer enterprise solutions, including national and international long-distance services for carriers. With a subscriber base exceeding 574 million as of 2023, we are committed to delivering effective products that contribute to the realization of a 'Digital India', enabling millions of individuals to connect and thrive for a brighter future.  Our presence spans 7,915 census and 802,577 non-census towns and villages, covering almost 96% of the country's population with 388,726 Rkms of optical fiber and an extensive distribution network of 1.2 million outlets. We've also implemented conservation initiatives that have saved 14,676 MWh of electricity, 4412 tonnes of paper through our e-bill initiatives, and recycled 3330 tonnes of e-waste.  At Airtel, we believe in taking early ownership, delivering quality, and experimenting with various career paths to boost our trajectories and gain valuable insights into the business, making us the best in the industry. We are committed to creating the ultimate experience for our consumers while maintaining an ecological balance in the world.

basic_profile.name: Nandan Sharma
basic_profile.headline: Senior Vice President at Zupee
basic_profile.summary:
I’m passionate about building businesses that solve meaningful problems and scale with purpose. Over the years, I’ve worked across diverse leadership roles — from launching new business lines to driving strategic growth initiatives and leading cross-functional teams in dynamic, high-growth environments.

What excites me is the challenge of transforming ideas into outcomes. Whether it’s navigating market uncertainty, crafting growth strategies, or building teams that move fast and think big — I believe in staying hands-on, data-informed, and people-first.

Recently, I enhanced my leadership toolkit through an Executive Education program at Kellogg School of Management, where I engaged with global leaders on strategy, innovation, and leading organizational change.

At my core, I’m driven by curiosity and a bias for action. I enjoy working at the intersection of strategy, execution, and leadership — building not just companies, but cultures that endure.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Airtel was founded to provide global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our organization embodies a unique blend of energy, innovation, creativity, dedication, scale, and ownership, all aimed at being limitless. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for our consumers.  Our team is highly skilled and constantly growing, actively developing infrastructure to introduce cutting-edge technologies like 5G, IoT, IQ, and Airtel Black. We have successfully launched 5G services in over 5,000 cities and towns nationwide, with 10 million unique customers on the 5G network nationally. Airtel Black is another convenient consumer service that provides combined billing for family and friends under a single bill. We also offer enterprise solutions, including national and international long-distance services for carriers. With a subscriber base exceeding 574 million as of 2023, we are committed to delivering effective products that contribute to the realization of a 'Digital India', enabling millions of individuals to connect and thrive for a brighter future.  Our presence spans 7,915 census and 802,577 non-census towns and villages, covering almost 96% of the country's population with 388,726 Rkms of optical fiber and an extensive distribution network of 1.2 million outlets. We've also implemented conservation initiatives that have saved 14,676 MWh of electricity, 4412 tonnes of paper through our e-bill initiatives, and recycled 3330 tonnes of e-waste.  At Airtel, we believe in taking early ownership, delivering quality, and experimenting with various career paths to boost our trajectories and gain valuable insights into the business, making us the best in the industry. We are committed to creating the ultimate experience for our consumers while maintaining an ecological balance in the world.

past.employee_description:
Scaled Zoto from the start of 1.5 million registered users in just 12 months.

Brand marketing: Zoto suffered from lack of trust and product understanding at user level. 
A series of controlled experiments using a mix of highly targeted media helped moved key metrics phenomenally. Brand searches grew by 44%, activation rate improved by 15%, Organic user grew by 18% and CPI for paid went down by 9%. 

Performance marketing: Despite a low Cost per install from paid channels like FB and Google, only 9% of the paid users were actually transacting, thus making the cost per acquiring a new transacting user from paid channels not scalable. Instead of focusing on a top funnel approach, I focused on improving the onboarding rate, activation rate and focused on channels that got in quality users. Reduced cost of transacting acquisitions from paid by 25% (YOY);  

Revenue growth: Increased monthly transacting users by 65% (YOY); Achieved this by breaking the problem statement into three parts (Acquisition, Revival & Retention) and conducting multiple experiments focused on each. Increased order volumes by 200% (YOY); achieved this by modeling a segmented user approach focused on increasing ARPU. Improved retention by 52% (YOY); achieved this by quality acquisitions and understanding new user data to create programs that reduced churn at early stage.

Viral growth: Conducted multiple experiments around referral, influencer & PR to build a viral growth engine central to the product. Referral contributed to 50% of the new user growth with the highest activation rate.  News jacking PR delivered 12X media value and even delivered on growth. 


Marketing burn: Reduced burn as a % of GMV by 60% (YOY); achieved this with multiple experiments including segmented offers, gamification & effective communication in app and on CRM channels. Improved activation rate by 35% (YOY); Worked on improving the conversion funnel post on-boarding.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Leo

OYO is a global platform that aims to empower entrepreneurs and small businesses with hotels and homes by providing full-stack technology products and services that aims to increase revenue and ease operations; bringing easy-to-book, affordable, and trusted accommodation to customers around the world. OYO offers 40+ integrated products and solutions to patrons who operate over 157K hotel and home storefronts in more than 35 countries including India, Europe, and Southeast Asia.OYO was founded by 27-year-old Ritesh Agarwal, the first Asian resident to be accepted to the Thiel Fellowship (started by Paypal founder Peter Thiel).OYO operates a unique business model that helps its patrons transform fragmented, unbranded and underutilized hospitality assets into branded, digitally-enabled storefronts with higher revenue generation potential and provides its customers with access to a broad range of high-quality storefronts at compelling price points. Owners and operators of over 157K storefronts use the OYO platform to manage all mission-critical aspects of their business operations. OYO’s comprehensive, full-stack technology suite integrates more than 40 products and services across digital sign-up and onboarding, revenue management, daily business management and D2C stacks into two flagship patron applications, Co-OYO and OYO OS. OYO customers can book storefronts through OYO’s own D2C channels and through indirect channels with third-party OTAs. The OYO App offers a variety of digital tools to guide customers throughout their journey, including discovery, seamless booking, pre-stay assistance, cancellations, digital check-ins as well as in-stay and post-stay services. With over 100 mn downloads, the OYO App was the 3rd most downloaded travel app in 2020. OYO Wizard, OYO’s loyalty program, has 9.2 million members and is the second largest loyalty program run by a travel or food brand in India, by subscriber base.

basic_profile.name: Rajnish Kumar
basic_profile.headline: Author of Made in Fire 🔥 | Co-founder & Group Co-CEO, ixigo | Building AI-native products, growth engines, teams and companies
basic_profile.summary: I have spent nearly two decades building ixigo. Made in Fire is the book I wish someone had handed me when we started.It is not a story about everything going right.It is about what building actually feels like from the inside: surviving the 2008 financial crisis, watching bookings fall to zero during COVID, finding true believers, building a culture that survives pressure, obsessing over users, scaling without losing your soul, and constantly reinventing yourself as technology changes.I co-founded ixigo in 2007 with a simple ambition: use technology to make travel better for millions of Indians. That journey has taken us through multiple near-death experiences, pivots, acquisitions, two IPO attempts, a public listing, and now another fundamental reinvention around AI.Along the way, I became increasingly interested in a larger question:Why do some teams keep building, innovating and surviving while others stop evolving?Made in Fire is my attempt to answer that question through the lessons we learnt the hard way.I write and speak about:• Building enduring startup cultures• Product and customer obsession• Growth and distribution• Finding and developing exceptional people• Full-stack thinking and high-agency teams• Innovation and reinvention• AI-native companies and the future of work• Founder resilience, health and longevityMade in Fire: A Playbook for Builders, Believers and Future Founders is published by Penguin Business.🔥 madeinfire.co

past.employer_linkedin_description: Doubtnut leverages technology to make education accessible for all.We have created an App using which students can ask study questions in Math by clicking the picture of the problem or concept. Subject matter experts then create a Khan Academy style video to answer each doubt. Why video, because in our experience as teacher/educator we have seen students not being able to understand text solutions. In fact around 30% of the questions asked on doubtnut so far are actually solved examples from textbooks. The reason for this could be twofold: i. Text solutions are usually the most optimal solution, which might not be the most intuitive one ii. Also, the solutions are optimized for printing hence not all logic and thoughts behind the problem solving are written. With video solution we try not only to find the answer but also make students aware of the problem solving approach employed by the expert. This will lead to deeper understanding of the concept. As of today the low teacher to student ratio and unavailability of good teachers are the biggest hurdles to effective doubt resolution. Doubtnut solves for it by reusing content that has already been created to resolve the doubts, because more students find the same question tough. Hence, a huge number of doubts can be resolved with limited number of teachers. Also the time required to create a video of ‘n’ minutes is ‘n+2’ minutes, which means the marginal cost is minimal, and will reduce to zero over time as we will have videos for most types of questions. Currently, we are working on developing technology to automate answering of questions asked previously using image recognition and Natural Language Processing.

basic_profile.summary:
If you ask me what's the one big innovation by humankind, I would give it to the "internet" without a second thought! 

In a world where the internet has fueled innovation and made technology easily accessible to remote places of the world, Marketing is no longer about promoting product attributes, but making an emotional connection with the consumer/customer

I am a marketer building brands/businesses on three pillars, One - Emotional Connect, Two - Consumer Insights & Three - Purpose! I believe that any brand can become successful if laid on these pillars. These three pillars have laid the foundation my career, helping me win multiple awards at all the places I had worked and also helped me in solving three business cases in HUL LIME Season 9, ending up as National Runners up

I am currently working as a Marketing Manager in Softlines Private Brands at Amazon managing performance marketing, brand presentation & traffic planning for the channels. I plan, phase, and manage a budget of around 25 Cr in ad spend and lead the data analysis and reporting while diving deep to bring in improvements. I work customer backward by showcasing the right product to the right customer at right time thereby improving the conversions

Prior to Amazon, I was working with udaan, which gave me a new perspective on how exciting work can be especially with a lot of customer problem statements to solve. It always puts me in a bootstrapping mode which enables me to think about the problem from a whole new perspective by understanding the customers, knowing their pain points, and gaining insights from the markets. I worked on category marketing which involved merchandising, improving traffic health (repeats, loyalty, AOV, Wallet share), mega-event planning & execution, digital marketing, customer engagement, growth hacking for new D2C brands, and trade promotions for multiple brands including launching a private label

Prior to that, I was working with Johnson & Johnson managing three brands in the skincare portfolio including their P&L, communication, and customer connect

Prior to my MBA, I was working as an executive in the Innovation Team of Titan Company Ltd. where I was part of a team that tries to bring in the "WOW" factor in the customer experience!

The one thing that excites me the most is innovation. I strongly believe that Innovation could be or rather should be in everything we do and there definitely is abundant scope. We just need to ask the right questions to gain the critical insight that fuels innovation!

Power your finance, grow your business.Razorpay is India’s first full-stack financial solutions company. We are on a mission to enhance the payment experience of over 300 million end consumers. And in doing so, we aim to enable Indian businesses - big and small - accept payments digitally with minimal effort and maximum ease. Razorpay has grown from being a payment gateway provider to a solutions-driven organization boasting of an extensive products suite to accept and disburse payments as well as raise capital and park money. In a nutshell, we fit into every nook and corner where your business touches money. #OutgrowOrdinaryWe identify ourselves as disruptors in the digital payments space and our vision is to power the financial ecosystem for other disruptors. Like attracts like and Razorpay actively looks to partner with established companies and startups that have either broken the glass ceiling in their industry or are set to. The Razorpay Product Suite today comprises verticals, along with Payment Gateway, like Payment Links, Payment Pages, Subscriptions, Smart Collect, Route, Razorpay Capital, RazorpayX, Payroll and Thirdwatch.Razorpay was started in 2014 by two IIT Roorkee alumni, Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar. Just a short few years later, Razorpay has evolved into a 800-odd strong organization with some of the best talents in the country helping some of the best companies manage their money movement seamlessly.Certified coolWe are a bunch of spirited, ambitious and fun folks. And no, we’re not saying this ourselves--leading institutions have recognized Razorpay for the high trust and high-performance culture that we maintain. Our strength lies in the people we are and we go to great lengths to nurture a family of coders, designers, sellers, marketers, analysts, writers, runners, photographers, gamers, tinkerers, and above all, people who are dreamers and doers at the same time. Be a part of our exciting journey.

Radiance is the annual technology and research festival of mechanical department of IIT Bombay, planned and executed by its students. It serves a niche crowd who enjoy the concepts and theories involved in the field of engineering. This audience is mostly constituted of the student community currently studying engineering. Radiance works on different events throughout the year and aims at organizing an annual festival which aims to bring together this group of people from different parts of the country at one place to experiment their knowledge and explore the fields of engineering through- competitions, exhibitions, lectures and fun activities.Flagship events- VAIGYANIKI: Research paper presentation, this competition provides an excellent platform for building researchers and innovators to present their research work on a competitive platform to be evaluated by experts from the industry and academia.IDP(industry defined problem): This competition is a platform for students to step out of classroom and test their problem solving skills through practical engineering problems. Participants come up with interesting and innovative solutions to tackle the real-life problems faced by Industries. Avanti runs India’s largest interventions integrating technology to improve Math and Science achievement in secondary schools. Our programs currently cover over 50,000 students in government school classrooms and over 5 million students online.Avanti's products combine curriculum-aligned video content, workbooks and online and offline assessments. Our pedagogy, Peer Instruction focuses on helping teachers shift their behavior in the classroom from "teaching" to facilitating self-directed learning. Avanti's team works in close collaboration with government school administrators to help them enact high scale system transformation.In addition to system transformation work, millions of students study for free on Avanti's online learning platforms. Each week, our content receives over 5M views and helps over a million students.Avanti's interventions have helped increase Math achievement for Grade 9 students by 0.6 standard deviations in a single year (the highest recorded in any research study in secondary schools in India). Our college access programs focus on preparing students for the IIT JEE and NEET exams. Over 60% of our students from the Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Schools qualify these exams each year.

basic_profile.name: Prashant Gupta
basic_profile.headline: Principal Engineer, AI Products @ ixigo | Generative AI, LLM & Multi-Agent Systems | Conversational & Voice AI | Python, Node.js, Distributed Systems
basic_profile.summary: Principal Engineer building production AI systems at ixigo, one of India's largest travel platforms. Ten years in backend engineering; since 2024, entirely on LLM-powered voice and agentic products.I designed the multi-agent orchestration layer that ixigo's AI products run on — agent routing, tool calling against live booking systems, short- and long-term memory, and deterministic fallback when a model or downstream service degrades. It began as the backbone of our voice-calling platform and is now reused across the company's agentic products.What I've shipped:• TARA — in-app voice-to-voice assistant. Full-duplex streaming speech with interruption handling, so users can talk over the agent and it recovers mid-turn. The agent navigates the app alongside the user and reaches search, booking, check-in and PNR by calling tools under that user's own authenticated session, so it can only ever act within their entitlements. ~40,000 conversations a day.• AI voice-calling platform. Replaced ixigo's legacy IVR and now carries most inbound and outbound call volume autonomously, with short- and long-term caller memory. Complex intents such as cancellations transfer to a human agent live, on the same call, with context carried across.• Evaluation platform. Built the harness our AI products ship against: replay of production conversations scored on 10+ parameters including agent task completion and ASR correctness, run as a release gate rather than a dashboard.• Echo — conversation intelligence. Model-graded scoring across CX and AI conversations, calibrated against human-rated samples until agreement held and then run without the human layer. Categorises user issues and routes product feedback automatically.• PLAN — AI itinerary generation bringing non-transactional users onto the platform.Before AI, I led ixigo's flights backend (2019–2024): a monolith-to-microservices migration with a team of 11, and a probabilistic booking-distribution service that doubled margin on routed flight bookings.I give technical direction to 10+ engineers and work with product and business leadership on what gets built. Earlier: farmer-outreach and crop-insurance platforms at FarmGuide, UPI payments at Abyeti, and an open-source contribution to Stack Overflow's Stacks Editor.Gurugram · prashant.gupta1194@gmail.com

current.employee_description:
Lead data science across pricing, risk, and conversion systems, owning ML end-to-end from problem framing to production.
 
Travel Guarantee: Architected a premium-pricing engine converting PNR risk probabilities into guarantee pricing, driving multi-million ₹ daily revenue.
 
PNR Confirmation Prediction Engine: Deployed a waitlist-confirmation model serving ~20M daily queries, peaking at ~450 queries/sec. Evaluated on PR-AUC and calibration, with probabilities feeding guarantee pricing directly and validated via reliability curves. Powers Trip Guarantee and multiple booking-funnel decisions.
 
Built a production RAG-based Text-to-SQL engine letting non-technical teams query data warehouses in plain English, using FAISS retrieval over schema context, grounded with GPT-4o.
 
Own end-to-end ML architecture, from feature engineering to real-time inference (FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, Prefect), drift monitoring, retraining, and A/B design with Product, Growth, and Engineering.

• Managing team of 20+ skilled NOC, SRE and DevOps.

basic_profile.name: Rajnish Kumar
basic_profile.headline: Author of Made in Fire 🔥 | Co-founder & Group Co-CEO, ixigo | Building AI-native products, growth engines, teams and companies
basic_profile.summary: I have spent nearly two decades building ixigo. Made in Fire is the book I wish someone had handed me when we started.It is not a story about everything going right.It is about what building actually feels like from the inside: surviving the 2008 financial crisis, watching bookings fall to zero during COVID, finding true believers, building a culture that survives pressure, obsessing over users, scaling without losing your soul, and constantly reinventing yourself as technology changes.I co-founded ixigo in 2007 with a simple ambition: use technology to make travel better for millions of Indians. That journey has taken us through multiple near-death experiences, pivots, acquisitions, two IPO attempts, a public listing, and now another fundamental reinvention around AI.Along the way, I became increasingly interested in a larger question:Why do some teams keep building, innovating and surviving while others stop evolving?Made in Fire is my attempt to answer that question through the lessons we learnt the hard way.I write and speak about:• Building enduring startup cultures• Product and customer obsession• Growth and distribution• Finding and developing exceptional people• Full-stack thinking and high-agency teams• Innovation and reinvention• AI-native companies and the future of work• Founder resilience, health and longevityMade in Fire: A Playbook for Builders, Believers and Future Founders is published by Penguin Business.🔥 madeinfire.co

basic_info.description: By 2050 world food production has to be 2.5 times current levels while dealing with rapid loss of agricultural land to urbanization, dramatic changes in climate, deep impact of cancer causing chemicals as well as changing food habits. If there is one individual who is dealing with these massive problems on a daily basis, problems which even the most resourceful and powerful people, organizations and governments are grappling with, it is the farmer. And to think that our food security and by extension the survival of the species is dependent on the farmer working around these challenges without help, can easily demonstrate the magnitude of the problems staring at us., , FarmBee is at the forefront of solving this through the use of digital technology - making world class, data driven precision agriculture solutions available to farmers at a fraction of the cost., , We believe that problems of the magnitude that can impact hundreds of millions, require really smart people solving it. Talk to any of our people and you can feel the passion, creativity and optimism for building solutions on behalf of farmers and the agri ecosystem. We also welcome people of diverse skill sets, backgrounds and preferences to join us in this quest to move the world forward.

Founded in 2013, AgroStar is one of India’s foremost AgTech start-ups, working on the mission of Helping Farmers Win. AgroStar is an end-to-end solutions provider that is solving three major problems of farmers - limited access to good quality agri inputs, a gap in knowledge and information about scientific farming practices, and a lack of access to the best markets to sell their produce. Today, AgroStar serves millions of farmers across seven Indian states via an omnichannel approach. We have built India’s largest Agri Advisory Center, a highly engaged digital farmer network on the AgroStar app, with over 7.5 million users and a retail network of 7000+ stores (rapidly expanding). Through the acquisition of INI Farms, a leader in pomegranate, banana and fresh cuts exports from India, AgroStar is helping farmers sell their produce to some of the largest retail chains spread across 25+ countries in the world. Thus, building a full-stack model, solving for farmers’ problems end to end. Our platform, powered by data and technology, helps us to solve the problems faced by farmers at scale, thereby driving us closer to our mission of Helping Farmers Win.

basic_profile.summary:
2025 Missions: Build better (web3) community. Be a better promoter for the voice of hope and optimism.

Thanks for stopping by! Let me start by saying, be more bold in what you do; I'm starting to realize more and more as I get older, pick, commit, and if it fails, adapt. I believe most of us are here to make the world a better place than where we found it. Yes, most of us.

I love people (humanity, compassion, empathy first, please!) and I love learning (tech and just science in general, history, everything really). I'm a technical recruiter who focuses on relationships to find matches between what you want and what you're looking for.

I love helping people - sharing market intel, doing a little career guidance, whatever. Don't believe me? Read my recommendations. 

This is me affecting a bit of the change I hope to see in the world. So don't be shy, reach out. Additional things we can talk about, IYKYK: EDC, homesteading, passive house/net zero, four seasons greenhouses & gardening, geothermal, solar, wind power generation, cooking, sauna, and a few other topics I seem to be constantly reading up and researching on.

Oh, I'm also kind of interested in AI these days. =)

My missions:
-ending poverty (UBI - universal basic income) through crypto. I hope to get there one day, and would love to network with people who have similar interests.
-revamping eduction and the way we think: big fan of contextual learning for schools
-ending world hunger - greentech, biodiversity
-"crazy" business ideas and spreading the word

E: td.techrec@gmail.com

https://www.hedgeforhumanity.org/

Ich habe die Expansion mit Standorten in 𝐃𝐞𝐮𝐭𝐬𝐜𝐡𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝, 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐮𝐧𝐝 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 maßgeblich begleitet – die Unternehmensgruppe wuchs in dieser Zeit auf über 𝟓𝟎𝟎 𝐌𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐞𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐞 𝐰𝐞𝐥𝐭𝐰𝐞𝐢𝐭.Als HR-Manager und Teamleiter habe ich 𝐌𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐞𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐞 𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐠𝐞𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐞𝐭, 𝐓𝐞𝐚𝐦𝐬 𝐰𝐞𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐰𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐥𝐭 und gleichzeitig als einer der erfolgreichsten Headhunter hunderte Fach- und Führungskräfte vermittelt.Darauf aufbauend habe ich mehrere eigene Recruiting- und Tech-Unternehmen gegründet – ich bin 𝐮. 𝐚. current.employee_description:
We are building an Autonomous Cybersecurity Workforce Platform.
Security teams today face a growing execution gap: attacks are becoming more sophisticated, security stacks are generating more alerts and tasks, and skilled cybersecurity talent remains limited.
Our approach is not another copilot, chatbot, or point solution.
We are building a workforce of AI cybersecurity experts, each specialized in a different security domain, working alongside human teams, operating across the existing security stack, and executing complex workflows end-to-end.
These AI experts are designed to analyze, investigate, optimize, coordinate, and continuously execute security programs — taking ownership of the time-consuming operational work that consumes security teams today.
The result is a new operating model for SecOps and ITSecOps: humans focus on judgment, priorities, strategy, and critical decisions, while an autonomous AI workforce drives execution at scale.
Our vision is to give every security team access to specialized cybersecurity expertise — on demand, across every domain, and embedded directly into the way security work gets done.

current.employer_linkedin_description: A Canalize é a plataforma de Partner Relationship Management (PRM) criada para transformar canais indiretos em motores de crescimento previsível. Com uma interface simples e focada na jornada do parceiro, centralizamos a gestão de leads, comissões, treinamentos e performance em um único lugar.Por que a Canalize?Diferente de um CRM tradicional, cujo foco é no cliente final, a nossa plataforma foi desenhada para apoiar e dar visão dos resultados dos parceiros. Permitimos que as empresas mantenham o seu CRM interno organizado, enquanto oferecem aos parceiros um portal intuitivo para registro de oportunidades e acompanhamento de métricas.A nossa missão é tornar a tecnologia de PRM acessível a empresas que desejam expandir as suas operações indiretas com total controle, profissionalismo e escala.Estamos construindo o futuro dos ecossistemas de vendas no Brasil, unindo tecnologia, método e foco em resultados.

past.employer_linkedin_description: A Edenred é líder global em Benefícios & Engajamento e Mobilidade. past.employer_linkedin_description: O conceito do California Coffee® nasceu quando visitamos o Brasil. Uma questão nos surpreendeu. Porque o maior exportador de café do mundo, que produz um café tão fino e de alta qualidade, não tem a oportunidade de saborear o melhor do que produz? A resposta é muito simples: A maioria da produção dos melhores e mais finos cafés é vendida para a exportação. Os fundadores do California Coffee® decidiram, então, trazer a idéia de "Specialty Coffee House" para o Brasil. California Coffee® oferece apenas a melhor classe de café arábica, cultivado em regiões especialmente selecionadas. Lá o café é plantado em grandes altitudes, o que leva a um crescimento mais lento e a um sabor mais fino. O nosso café é selecionado a partir dos melhores grãos de exportação.California Coffee® se destaca por ser intransigente quanto a qualidade, o frescor e o serviço personalizado e reconhecido. Nossa meta é garantir o melhor copo de café possível, sem levar em consideração o custo ou o esforço exigido. Torrado o nosso café artesanalmente de acordo com os mais rígidos padrões europeus em nossa própria torrefação. Trabalhando continuamente para melhorar a qualidade e a consistência do café para trazer o melhor de cada grão para você.Finalmente, o maior produtor mundial já pode beber o mesmo café servido nos mais finos Coffee Shops do mundo.California Coffee®, no Brasil desde 2002.

basic_profile.name: Michael Shin, CAMS
basic_profile.headline: Chief Compliance Officer at Loop | Building AI-native compliance infrastructure in stealth
basic_profile.summary: I started building on the internet at 13. I taught myself HTML, created community and entertainment websites, learned distribution by submitting them to early search engines, and earned US$200 to US$500 per month from overseas advertising networks before I understood what a startup was. At 16, I moved alone from Korea to Canada without family or an existing network. That experience taught me to solve problems without waiting for permission, become comfortable with rejection, and keep moving until I found a path forward. I later spent more than 18 years in banking, payments, crypto, and fintech, progressing from an AML investigator at BMO to Chief Compliance Officer and Head of Compliance roles. I have built AML programs, regulatory frameworks, risk and control systems, and compliance operations for regulated financial products.  Along the way, I worked inside both large financial institutions and early-stage companies. I helped launch regulated products, worked with banks and regulators across jurisdictions, and led teams responsible for compliance, operations, and growth.  Today, I am now building in stealth at the intersection of AI, financial compliance, and regulated operations.I believe AI creates an unusual opportunity for domain experts. Problems that previously required large engineering teams and significant capital can now be translated directly into working software by people who understand the underlying workflows, risks, and customer needs.My view is that AI should not replace accountable human judgment. It should remove the repetitive analysis, coordination, documentation, and maintenance surrounding the decisions for which professionals must remain accountable.I cannot control luck, but I can increase the chances of encountering it by continuing to build, ask, and show up. After nearly two decades in regulated finance, I am returning to what I enjoyed most at 13: learning a new technology, building something useful, and taking it to market. This time, I understand the problem, the industry, and the customer. This time, I intend to take it all the way.

Swiss Blue Energy is developing power generation systems that use low temperature heat streams between 20 to 80°C (68 to 176°F) as energy source. Waste heat is one of the world's largest energy sources with heat losses of over 50% in industrial processes. Other potential areas of consideration include thermal power plants, as well as geothermal and solar thermal energy. Based on Thomas Alpha Edison's Pyromagnetic Motor (first patented in 1888, former US Patent no. 380 100) and Nikola Tesla’s Thermo-Magnetic Motor (first patented in 1889, former US Patent no. 396 121)  Swiss Blue Energy has developed a system which is able to generate non-fluctuating electricity out of low temperature waste heat streams below 80°C (176°F) in an emission-free, reliable, and affordable way. With the unique technology, the - so far untapped - energy source of low temperature heat can now be converted directly into useable zero-emission electricity. The market for our technology is limitless – if the planned scale-up and industrialization of our technology is achieved. We currently collaborate with national and international research institutions and industry partners for waste heat recovery pilot installations. Additionally, we are looking for other interested partners to develop the technology to maturity. We are offering the unique opportunity to participate in the establishment of a step-change technology in low temperature waste heat recovery. With the modular system for de-centralized and zero-emission electricity production, we will substantially contribute to a more sustainable energy supply.   Swiss Blue Energy – the ingenious way to energy transformation!

I founded the NUESA Academic Platform as a nonprofit academy to assist students in our faculty who were struggling academically. We built the system around the Socratic method of teaching, which revolves around asking questions to stimulate critical thinking and learning.

Our approach was simple: we grouped students based on their courses and academic levels, and each week, we provided them with a set of questions designed to test what they had learned so far. Students were expected to answer these questions and raise any additional ones they had. Their peers often voluntarily helped answer, and when needed, the coordinator of NAP stepped in to provide further clarity.

This initiative supported about 2,000 first- and second-year students across various departments, including science, technology, arts, social sciences, education, and foundational counseling. It not only helped them prepare for exams and review lessons but also fostered peer learning and collaboration. For new students who were still adapting to university life, it was an opportunity to get extra support without any additional cost.

Unfortunately, after I completed my program, the platform had to shut down. The level of interest and the heavy management it required made it unsustainable without ongoing involvement.

We founded Lavender Tutors as a social enterprise in Nigeria with the goal of supporting poor and underperforming secondary school students who were falling behind in one subject or another. Our research showed that the average Nigerian classroom has 15-30 students, each with different backgrounds, interests, and learning speeds. It became clear that many students struggled in certain subjects, while excelling in others. Yet, the school system often assumes that all students should learn at the same pace, without providing adequate support for those who lag behind after the traditional 45-minute lessons.
Our vision for Lavender Tutors was to create a team of passionate educators dedicated to helping each student improve in their weaker areas, with the hope that they would eventually grow to love the subject and pursue it further. 
While it might sound like a regular tutorial service, our approach was more specialized. We assessed each student's unique challenges and provided tailored solutions, much like a medical specialist diagnosing and treating a specific issue. Additionally, we partnered with schools to track each student's progress and ensure they were improving.
We designed Lavender Tutors to be accessible to low-income students by implementing systems like the "1 for 1" payment model, allowing us to support those in need. In 2022, we decided to transition from a brick-and-mortar operation to a digital platform, which is now known as LearnPlanet.

basic_profile.name: Mark Belinsky
basic_profile.headline: Hardware & Software Product Innovation | Corporate & Government Strategy | Startup Founder
basic_profile.summary:
Building beautiful things that help lots of people is my driving passion.

Whether leading companies or driving product, I’m a creative technologist. I’m a big believer that beauty and efficiency drive results, both inside companies and with customers. I try to infuse this ethos across all divisions of an organization with agile methodologies and wonderful brand experiences. More often than not, I've worked with small teams under tight deadlines, meaning I can roll up my sleeves and dive into the trenches to execute in a variety of roles in order to get the exemplary results I demand of any project I lead.

My inspirations are leaders, from Benjamin Franklin to Muhammad Yunus, who fused technological innovation with creative inspiration, all while seeking to make a positive difference in the world. My voracious curiosity drives me to dive deep into any problem. I search beyond obvious ideas and work hard to determine the right blend of design, technology and strategy for a strong return on investment.

Spotting global trends early is one of my strengths and helps me promote solutions I'm enthusiastic about at the right time. From founding the nonprofit Digital Democracy in 2008 to now working as an innovation specialist at the United Nations Development Programme to integrate digital as a pillar of development, my ability to ideate and implement solutions to systemic, nascent problems, makes me a critical player in the human rights and innovation space.

Across domains like smart home IoT, interactive media, international development, sustainable tourism, product innovation, security and blockchain, I've raised venture capital funding, developed partnerships and represented companies in the media. I’ve shared these experiences as a speaker at SXSW, Tribeca Film Festival, and Hackers On Planet Earth, as a guest on BBC, Al-Jazeera, and NPR, lecturing at Harvard, Columbia and NYU, helping advise the Federal Reserve Bank of New York on blockchain technologies, and consulting with the US State Department, Fortune 500 companies, and several heads of state.

Above all, the specialities I most enjoy focusing my time on include business strategy, agile design, brand storytelling, public speaking, media production, and hardware + software development. I’m also big into biking absurdly long distances, love exploring new cuisines, and I make a solid Negroni.

past.employee_title: Head of Scaled Insight Science, Amazon Ads
past.employee_description:
I led a team that’s building a true data driven GTM engine.

Most sales organizations are designed “tops down”. You take some accounts, hire sales reps, and give them quota. Sophisticated organizations may use data to segment accounts, set the right quota, optimize account loads, and give sales people productivity tools. However the sales reps day to day activities are often a black box.

At Amazon Ads, my team is taking a different approach. We want to have a bottoms up model to give the optimal message at the optimal time to each advertiser. So we built a tool that provides autogenerated content to account teams for each advertiser each month using science. These are pre generated PPT decks that trigger when a ML model shows a meaningful opportunity, explains the opportunity to the advertiser, and delivers recommendations scientifically shown to capture the opportunity. We build tools to see how our account teams modify our content and how the customer responds. This creates a flywheel to help us understand all customer touch points and advertiser insights needed to make our advertisers successful. 

Once we have this (we power 20% of advertiser pitches now and are targeting 50% by end of 2023; $XXX hundred of millions in incremental revenue impact) we can build a truly data driven GTM engine. We will be to answer all of the Sales Data science questions (segmentation, lifecycle, account team composition, targets) in a truly bottoms up fashion while enabling granular performance management of our sales teams. We’ll also be able to add marketing and in product touch points to build a true data driven cross channel GTM engine.

NOTE: My official title started as "Head of Data Science, Field Sales", but the role quickly morphed into a data products role, so I am reflecting that on LinkedIn for simplicity

basic_profile.name: Julia / Jules Herd
basic_profile.headline: Managing Partner  at Stealth Mode Startup
basic_profile.summary:
I help transformative tech founders bridge the gap between great product and market authority.
With 25 years in the game - from co-leading Microsoft at Weber Shandwick to global roles at HTC, Deezer, and AMD - I’ve seen exactly where scale-ups fail. It’s rarely the tech; it’s the inability to align their narrative with their commercial goals.
Through my consultancy, Five in a Boat, I provide the comms seat at the board for tech companies. I don't just secure press; I architect market positioning that protects valuations and drives revenue.
Why work with me?
Founder Perspective: I’ve launched a drinks brand and scaled an EV cable company to be the UK’s largest. I understand your P&L, not just your PR.
Board-Level Strategy: I move beyond clips to investor readiness and stakeholder alignment.
Deep Sector Expertise: From Seed to Global Scale, I’ve navigated the complexities of transformative tech.
I am also a huge proponent of transparency in leadership, speaking openly about the realities of entrepreneurship and personal resilience (including my own experiences with miscarriage). I believe the best leaders are the ones who show up as human beings.

Civics Unplugged ("CU") is a 501(c)(3) shaping young leaders to build the future they want and deserve. Our programs prepare young leaders to design civic innovations—new ideas and technologies that solve community and civic problems. More than 6,000 high school students are now a part of a tight-knit CU community that transcends differences. The Fellows connect across political, geographic, racial, and socioeconomic lines, united by their commitment to leading with integrity and innovation. These young leaders will be our future founders, legislators, judges, journalists, and teachers, all collaborating to set up a brighter future for us all.The current education system is failing to prepare our country’s next generation to create a brighter future. In schools, we fail to help students be creative or develop entrepreneurial skills. As they grow up, we discourage them from pursuing their passions or taking on meaningful social impact work. Worst of all – we’ve created an environment where young people everywhere feel disconnected from their peers, their voice, and any form of civic agency. We believe the loneliness crisis Gen Zers face spurs directly from the lack of opportunities to do fulfilling civic work in communities across the country – and creates one of the biggest threats to our democracy we’ve ever faced. That’s why we built Civics Unplugged.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Office of the Assessor-Recorder is responsible for fairly and accurately executing property assessment functions in accordance with the State Constitution and State and local laws. past.employer_linkedin_description: Civics Unplugged ("CU") is a 501(c)(3) shaping young leaders to build the future they want and deserve. Our programs prepare young leaders to design civic innovations—new ideas and technologies that solve community and civic problems. More than 6,000 high school students are now a part of a tight-knit CU community that transcends differences. The Fellows connect across political, geographic, racial, and socioeconomic lines, united by their commitment to leading with integrity and innovation. These young leaders will be our future founders, legislators, judges, journalists, and teachers, all collaborating to set up a brighter future for us all.The current education system is failing to prepare our country’s next generation to create a brighter future. In schools, we fail to help students be creative or develop entrepreneurial skills. As they grow up, we discourage them from pursuing their passions or taking on meaningful social impact work. Worst of all – we’ve created an environment where young people everywhere feel disconnected from their peers, their voice, and any form of civic agency. We believe the loneliness crisis Gen Zers face spurs directly from the lack of opportunities to do fulfilling civic work in communities across the country – and creates one of the biggest threats to our democracy we’ve ever faced. That’s why we built Civics Unplugged.

basic_profile.name: Daniel Jacob
basic_profile.headline: Sustainability Data Management - Founder & CEO
basic_profile.summary:
I help organizations turn fragmented sustainability and ESG data into decision-ready intelligence that creates measurable business value and meets investor, regulatory, and operational demands.

You want to know what sustainability and ESG means for your organization? You need to assess or improve your organization's ESG performance? You need support to build the business case for sustainability initiatives?
We help you and your organization identify, prioritize and report on material ESG factors, and support the deployment of sustainability solutions & strategies that will improve your ESG performance and generate quantified triple bottom line results: Financial, Environmental & Social.

Here's why: 
After working in Finance, Business Intelligence, Strategy and Business development for several years, I witnessed first-hand that businesses have opportunities to become more sustainable in a profitable way. I soon realized that without will from executives, changes are painstakingly slow.
During that time, I also co-founded 2 profitable startups with environmental aims. I then divested from these endeavors to help drive a bigger change. 
This is when the Changing Habits Movement was created, during a 1000 days world tour. It started with the aim of sparking change at the grass root level, and more than 60 environmental ideas & sustainable business model videos from more than 30 countries were created along the way, with the purpose of inspiring people & organizations to take action. Start small, but start somewhere!
This evolved into Changing Habits Solutions, a Montreal based sustainable business strategy firm helping organizations integrate sustainability and ESG metrics in their decision process by deploying ESG systems and governance. 
We then help companies identify and deploy solutions that will improve their ESG performance while generating quantified triple bottom line returns: Financial, Environmental & Social.
 
The move towards sustainable business practices is not a question of IF it will happen, but WHEN. 
Don't fall behind, and seize business opportunities in a transition economy: Think big, Start small, Scale fast!

If you've read all the way here, we should probably have a chat! 
Whether to learn about our services, join the team or initiate a partnership, please reach out: daniel@changinghabits.solutions

During that time, I also co-founded 2 profitable startups with environmental aims. I then divested from these endeavors to help drive a bigger change. 
This is when the Changing Habits Movement was created, during a 1000 days world tour. It started with the aim of sparking change at the grass root level, and more than 60 environmental ideas & sustainable business model videos from more than 30 countries were created along the way, with the purpose of inspiring people & organizations to take action. Start small, but start somewhere!
This evolved into Changing Habits Solutions, a Montreal based sustainable business strategy firm helping organizations integrate sustainability and ESG metrics in their decision process by deploying ESG systems and governance. 
We then help companies identify and deploy solutions that will improve their ESG performance while generating quantified triple bottom line returns: Financial, Environmental & Social.
 
The move towards sustainable business practices is not a question of IF it will happen, but WHEN. 
Don't fall behind, and seize business opportunities in a transition economy: Think big, Start small, Scale fast!

If you've read all the way here, we should probably have a chat! 
Whether to learn about our services, join the team or initiate a partnership, please reach out: daniel@changinghabits.solutions

Mein Aufgabenbereich umfasst die aktive Identifikation und Bewertung vielversprechender Gründungsteams sowie die systematische Analyse ihrer unternehmerischen Vorhaben entlang zentraler Innovations- und Wachstumskriterien.
